domains.name: treatment
domains.description: Authoritative domain for all water treatment and purification operations at WTPs and WWTPs. Owns process data for coagulation, filtration, disinfection (UV, chlorination, RO, UF, MF, GAC), CT compliance, chemical dosing, and finished water production. Integrates with SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time process control and MOR regulatory submissions.
domains.references: EPA SDWA, WEF standards, AWWA treatment guidelines

products.name: facility
products.description: Master record for each Water Treatment Plant (WTP) or Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) facility. Captures facility identity, design capacity (MGD), treatment technology type (conventional, membrane, RO, UV, GAC), regulatory permit numbers, NPDES permit references, operational status, geographic location, and service area. This is the authoritative facility master for the treatment domain.
products.reference: WTP / WWTP Facility Master

products.name: process_reading
products.description: Time-series operational readings from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian for treatment process control points. Each record captures a sensor tag ID, timestamp, measured value, engineering unit (MGD, GPM, PSI, NTU, pH, mg/L, mW/cm², °C), quality flag, and source system. Includes all instrumented process telemetry: flow rates, pressures, turbidity, pH, chlorine residual, chemical feed rates, UV intensity/dose, and temperature. Serves as the silver-layer curated telemetry store for treatment operations, process trending, alarm validation, and regulatory compliance verification.
products.reference: SCADA / PI Historian Process Tag Reading

attributes.name: alarm_state
attributes.description: The SCADA alarm state associated with this reading at the time of capture. Reflects the process control alarm condition: normal (within operational bounds), low_alarm (below low setpoint), high_alarm (above high setpoint), low_low_alarm (critical low condition), high_high_alarm (critical high condition), sensor_fault (instrument malfunction detected). Used for operational response and incident tracking.
attributes.references: AWWA SCADA Alarm Management Standards; ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; OSIsoft PI Historian Alarm Configuration

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The data pipeline batch or job run identifier associated with the ingestion of this process reading into the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer. Used for ETL traceability, reprocessing identification, and data pipeline audit. Enables identification of all records loaded in a specific pipeline execution.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse ETL Audit Standards; OSIsoft PI Historian Connector Batch Processing

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the instrument generating this reading is due for its next calibration verification. Sourced from the IBM Maximo asset management calibration schedule. Readings captured after the calibration_due_date may require additional quality review. Supports instrument reliability and regulatory compliance for monitoring equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Measurement Equipment Calibration; AWWA Instrument Calibration Standards; EPA SDWA Monitoring Equipment Requirements

attributes.name: compression_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether OSIsoft PI Historian exception and compression algorithms were applied to this data point before archiving. When True, the stored value may represent a compressed/exception-filtered point rather than a raw scan value. Important for understanding data density and potential gaps in high-frequency process data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Exception and Compression Documentation; AWWA SCADA Data Integrity Standards

attributes.name: ct_required
attributes.description: The minimum CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) value in mg·min/L required by the EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) for the applicable disinfectant, temperature, and pH conditions at this facility. Used to calculate CT compliance ratio (ct_value / ct_required) for regulatory reporting. Null for non-disinfection parameters.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H; EPA CT Tables for Disinfection; State Primacy Agency Permit Conditions

attributes.name: ct_value
attributes.description: The calculated CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) value in mg·min/L for disinfection process readings. CT is the product of disinfectant residual concentration (mg/L) and contact time (minutes), used to demonstrate compliance with the Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) inactivation requirements for Giardia and viruses. Applicable only to disinfection process stage readings; null for non-disinfection parameters.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H; EPA Guidance Manual for Compliance with Filtration and Disinfection Requirements; AWWA Disinfection Standards

attributes.name: dmr_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this process reading is designated for inclusion in the Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR) submitted to the EPA or state agency under the facility's NPDES permit. True for effluent quality readings at WWTPs that must be reported on the DMR. Enables automated DMR data extraction.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES 40 CFR Part 122; DMR Reporting Requirements; CWA Section 402

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement associated with the measured_value field. Follows industry-standard engineering unit notation used in SCADA and PI Historian configurations. Common values include MGD (Million Gallons per Day), GPM (Gallons per Minute), PSI (Pounds per Square Inch), NTU (Nephelometric Turbidity Units), pH, mg/L (milligrams per Liter), and °C (degrees Celsius). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MGD|GPM|PSI|NTU|pH|mg/L|°C|%|mV|kW|gal|ft|ft/s|ppm|ppb|mS/cm|MPN/100mL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Engineering Standards; OSIsoft PI Historian Unit of Measure Configuration; NIST SI Units

attributes.name: high_range_limit
attributes.description: The maximum operational range limit for this process parameter as configured in the SCADA/PI Historian system. Values above this threshold may indicate sensor malfunction, process upset, or out-of-range conditions. Used in data quality validation and alarm management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; AWWA SCADA Alarm Management Standards

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this process reading record was ingested into the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer from the source system (OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA). Distinct from reading_timestamp (the real-world event time). Used for data pipeline latency monitoring and ETL audit trails.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Ingestion Standards; OSIsoft PI Historian Connector Audit

attributes.name: is_manual_entry
attributes.description: Indicates whether this process reading was manually entered by a licensed operator rather than automatically captured by the SCADA/PI Historian system. True for manual readings (e.g., grab sample results, field measurements, backup readings during SCADA outages). Required for data integrity auditing and regulatory compliance documentation under EPA SDWA.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Data Integrity Requirements; 40 CFR Part 141 Monitoring Recordkeeping; AWWA Operator Manual Entry Standards

attributes.name: is_regulatory_exceedance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured_value exceeds the applicable regulatory_limit_value for this process parameter. True when the reading constitutes a regulatory violation requiring notification, corrective action, and reporting under SDWA or NPDES permit conditions. Critical flag for compliance monitoring and MOR/DMR generation.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA 40 CFR Part 141; NPDES 40 CFR Part 122; State Primacy Agency Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent calibration verification performed on the instrument generating this reading. Sourced from IBM Maximo calibration records. Used to assess measurement reliability and support regulatory documentation of monitoring equipment maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Measurement Equipment Calibration; AWWA Instrument Calibration Standards; IBM Maximo Calibration Management

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: A human-readable description of the physical location within the treatment facility where this measurement point is installed (e.g., 'Filter Gallery - Filter 3 Effluent', 'Clearwell Inlet', 'UV Reactor Train 2 Outlet'). Supplements the tag_id with a plain-language location reference for operator use and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: AWWA Treatment Plant Operations Manual; EPA SDWA Monitoring Location Requirements

attributes.name: low_range_limit
attributes.description: The minimum operational range limit for this process parameter as configured in the SCADA/PI Historian system. Values below this threshold may indicate sensor malfunction, process upset, or out-of-range conditions. Used in data quality validation and alarm management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; AWWA SCADA Alarm Management Standards

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The principal numeric measurement captured at the process control point. Represents the raw or lightly-conditioned sensor reading as stored in OSIsoft PI Historian. Units are defined by the engineering_unit field. Examples: flow rate in MGD or GPM, pressure in PSI, turbidity in NTU, pH value, chlorine residual in mg/L, temperature in degrees Celsius.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Archive; AWWA M53; EPA SDWA MCL Monitoring

attributes.name: mor_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this process reading is designated for inclusion in the Monthly Operating Report (MOR) submitted to the state primacy agency. True for readings that represent regulatory compliance monitoring points required under the facility's operating permit. Enables automated MOR data extraction from the silver layer.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA MOR Reporting Requirements; State Primacy Agency Operating Permit Conditions; 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: The category of process parameter being measured. Classifies the reading into a standard measurement type for cross-facility analytics and regulatory reporting. Examples: flow (volumetric flow rate), pressure (hydraulic pressure), turbidity (particle measurement in NTU), pH (acidity/alkalinity), chlorine_residual (disinfectant residual in mg/L), temperature (process temperature), chemical_feed_rate (dosing rate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flow|pressure|turbidity|pH|chlorine_residual|temperature|chemical_feed_rate|level|conductivity|dissolved_oxygen|TOC|UV_transmittance|BOD|COD|TSS|TDS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Monitoring Requirements; AWWA Water Quality Standards; 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: pi_server_name
attributes.description: The name of the OSIsoft PI Historian server instance from which this reading was sourced. Water utilities may operate multiple PI servers across different facilities or regions. Used for data lineage, source system reconciliation, and multi-server federation queries.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Server Configuration; Databricks Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.description: The treatment process stage at which this reading was captured. Identifies the position within the treatment train for process control and regulatory compliance tracking. Key stages include intake (raw water source), coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection (UV/chlorination/RO/UF/MF/GAC), finished_water (post-treatment), and distribution_entry (point of entry to distribution network). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: intake|coagulation|flocculation|sedimentation|filtration|disinfection|finished_water|distribution_entry|wastewater_influent|secondary_treatment|tertiary_treatment|wastewater_effluent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); AWWA Treatment Plant Design; 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian data quality status code associated with this reading. Indicates the reliability and validity of the measured value. 'Good' indicates a valid, reliable reading. 'Bad' indicates a sensor fault or communication failure. 'Uncertain' indicates the value may be unreliable. 'Substituted' indicates a manually entered or interpolated value. 'Shutdown' indicates the process unit was offline. 'ConfigError' indicates a tag configuration issue.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Quality Codes; AWWA SCADA Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: raw_value
attributes.description: The unprocessed, unconditioned sensor output value as received directly from the SCADA/PI Historian system before any silver-layer transformations, scaling, or quality adjustments. Preserved for audit and reconciliation against the source system. May differ from measured_value if scaling, offset correction, or substitution was applied.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Raw Data Archive; Databricks Silver Layer Lineage Standards

attributes.name: reading_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which this process reading was recorded. Derived from reading_timestamp for partitioning, daily aggregation, and regulatory reporting purposes. Stored as a separate DATE column to support efficient date-based partitioning in the Databricks Lakehouse and daily compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Partitioning Standards; EPA Daily Monitoring Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: The silver-layer curation lifecycle status of this process reading record. 'raw' indicates the record has been ingested but not yet validated. 'validated' indicates the record has passed data quality checks. 'rejected' indicates the record failed validation rules. 'substituted' indicates the value was replaced by an operator-approved substitute. 'archived' indicates the record has been moved to long-term storage.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Quality Framework; AWWA Data Management Standards

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the process measurement was recorded by the SCADA/PI Historian system. This is the principal real-world event time for the observation, stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Distinct from ingestion or audit timestamps.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Event Timestamp; AWWA SCADA Standards; EPA SDWA Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: sample_interval_seconds
attributes.description: The configured sampling or scan interval in seconds at which this PI tag is polled or archived by the OSIsoft PI Historian system. Common intervals include 1 second (continuous process), 60 seconds (1-minute averages), 900 seconds (15-minute averages), and 3600 seconds (hourly averages). Used for time-series aggregation and data completeness assessment.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Archive Configuration; AWWA SCADA Data Collection Standards

attributes.name: scada_system_code
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system instance that collected and transmitted this process reading. Identifies the specific PLC, RTU, or HMI node in the control network. Used for source system traceability and SCADA infrastructure management.
attributes.references: AWWA SCADA Security Standards; ICS-CERT SCADA Security Guidelines; NIST SP 800-82

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this process reading was ingested. Identifies the originating data source for lineage tracking and data quality assessment. Primary source is OSIsoft PI Historian (PI_Historian). Other sources include direct SCADA feeds (SCADA_Direct), manual operator entries (Manual_Entry), LIMS laboratory imports (LIMS), and AMI platform feeds (AMI).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Integration Standards; Databricks Data Lineage Framework

attributes.name: source_tag_name
attributes.description: The original PI tag name or SCADA point name as it exists in the source system (OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA). Preserved for data lineage and reconciliation purposes. May differ from the normalized tag_id if tag renaming or aliasing has occurred during silver-layer curation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; SCADA Point Naming Standards

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the measured_value was substituted or manually overridden from the raw_value. Applicable when reading_status is 'substituted' or quality_flag is 'Substituted'. Required for regulatory audit trails under EPA SDWA data integrity requirements. Null when no substitution was applied.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Data Integrity Requirements; 40 CFR Part 141 Monitoring Recordkeeping; AWWA Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: treatment_process_type
attributes.description: The specific treatment technology or process type associated with this reading. Identifies the treatment method for process-specific analytics and compliance reporting. Values include conventional (coagulation/flocculation/sedimentation), UV (Ultraviolet Disinfection), chlorination, RO (Reverse Osmosis), UF (Ultrafiltration), MF (Microfiltration), GAC (Granular Activated Carbon), ozonation, softening, and ion_exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: conventional|UV|chlorination|RO|UF|MF|GAC|ozonation|softening|ion_exchange|biological|membrane_bioreactor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA LT2ESWTR; AWWA Treatment Technology Standards; 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this process reading record was validated and promoted to 'validated' status in the silver layer. Null if the record has not yet been validated or was rejected. Supports data quality audit trails and SLA monitoring for data availability.
attributes.references: Databricks Silver Layer Data Quality Framework; AWWA Data Management Standards

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Chemical dosing events (disinfection, coagulation) are performed to meet specific regulatory requirements (SWTR CT requirements, DBP formation rules). chemical_dose_event has ct_compliance_flag and re

attributes.name: target_contaminant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.contaminant. Business justification: Each chemical dose event targets a specific regulated contaminant (chlorine→pathogens, alum→turbidity). Replacing denormalized target_parameter text with FK to contaminant enables DBP formation risk a

attributes.name: water_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.water_sample. Business justification: Operators collect verification samples after chemical dosing (chlorine, fluoride) to confirm target residuals achieved. Links dose event to lab confirmation sample for regulatory compliance documentat

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IBM Maximo work order or SAP PM maintenance order associated with this dosing event, if the dosing was performed as part of a scheduled or corrective maintenance activity.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); SAP ERP PM Module

attributes.name: chemical_concentration_pct
attributes.description: The concentration of the chemical solution as dosed, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.5% sodium hypochlorite, 48% alum solution). Required for accurate mass-to-volume conversion and chemical inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Treatment Standards; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: chemical_mass_applied_kg
attributes.description: Total mass of active chemical ingredient applied during the dosing event, expressed in kilograms. Calculated from volume and concentration for solid or concentrated liquid chemicals. Used for regulatory reporting and chemical cost accounting.
attributes.references: EPA MOR/DMR Reporting; SAP ERP CO Cost Allocation

attributes.name: chemical_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the chemical dosed. Used for cost allocation by treatment function, regulatory reporting by chemical category, and chemical consumption analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: disinfectant|coagulant|flocculant|pH_adjustment|fluoridation|oxidant|corrosion_inhibitor|adsorbent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; AWWA Water Treatment Chemical Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chemical dose event record was first created in the Silver Layer data product, either via SCADA/PI Historian integration or manual entry. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Data Governance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: ct_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dosing event achieved the required CT value for regulatory disinfection compliance (True = compliant, False = non-compliant). Used for automated MOR/DMR compliance reporting and regulatory violation tracking.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA SWTR; 40 CFR Part 141.72; MOR Reporting

attributes.name: ct_required_mg_min_per_l
attributes.description: The minimum CT value required by EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) for the applicable temperature and pH conditions to achieve required log inactivation credits. Compared against ct_value_mg_min_per_l for compliance determination.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA SWTR; 40 CFR Part 141.72; State Primacy Agency

attributes.name: ct_value_mg_min_per_l
attributes.description: The calculated CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) value in mg·min/L, representing the product of disinfectant residual concentration and contact time. Required for Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) compliance and Giardia/virus inactivation credit calculations.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); 40 CFR Part 141.72; AWWA M20

attributes.name: dbp_formation_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dosing event parameters (dose rate, TOC level, temperature, pH) present an elevated risk of Disinfection Byproduct (DBP) formation, specifically Trihalomethanes (THM) and Haloacetic Acids (HAA5). Supports proactive DBP compliance management.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Disinfectants and Disinfection Byproducts Rule (DBPR); 40 CFR Part 141.64

attributes.name: dose_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the chemical dosing event concluded. Used with dose_start_timestamp to calculate dosing duration and total chemical volume applied. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; EPA SDWA CT Compliance

attributes.name: dose_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the chemical dosing event, typically sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA event log (e.g., 'CDE-2024-00123'). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA M20 Water Chlorination/Chloramination Practices

attributes.name: dose_event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chemical dosing event record. 'completed' indicates normal termination; 'aborted' indicates operator-interrupted dosing; 'failed' indicates pump or system failure; 'pending_review' indicates the record requires QA validation before regulatory submission.
attributes.references: Water Utilities O&M Procedures; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: dose_rate_mg_per_l
attributes.description: The chemical dose rate expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/L) of water treated. This is the primary dosing metric used for regulatory compliance verification, CT calculations, and comparison against Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) limits.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; AWWA M20 Water Chlorination; 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: dose_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the chemical dosing event commenced, as recorded by SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian. This is the principal real-world event timestamp for regulatory CT (Contact Time) compliance calculations.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; EPA SDWA CT Compliance; AWWA M20

attributes.name: dose_trigger_type
attributes.description: Indicates what initiated the dosing event: automatic SCADA/PLC control loop, manual operator action, scheduled dosing program, alarm response (e.g., low residual alarm), or regulatory requirement (e.g., CT compliance mandate).
attributes.references: SCADA/PLC Operations; EPA SDWA; AWWA M20

attributes.name: dosing_method
attributes.description: The method by which the chemical was applied: 'continuous' (steady-state pump injection), 'batch' (fixed volume addition), 'slug' (rapid high-concentration dose), or 'intermittent' (cyclic on/off dosing). Affects dose efficacy calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: AWWA M20 Water Chlorination; EPA Treatment Technique Guidance

attributes.name: dosing_pump_code
attributes.description: Reference to the dosing pump asset used to inject the chemical, as registered in IBM Maximo CMMS. Enables pump performance tracking, maintenance scheduling, and dose accuracy auditing.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); AWWA M20

attributes.name: event_dose_cost_usd
attributes.description: The total chemical cost in USD for this dosing event, calculated as chemical_mass_applied_kg multiplied by unit_cost_per_kg. Used for per-event cost allocation, treatment cost-per-MGD analytics, and OPEX reporting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP ERP FI/CO; GAAP; GASB; AWWA Cost of Service Studies

attributes.name: mcl_limit_mg_per_l
attributes.description: The applicable Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) or Maximum Contaminant Level Goal (MCLG) for the target parameter as set by EPA or state primacy agency. Stored at event time for point-in-time regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Primacy Agency

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the licensed operator to record observations, anomalies, equipment issues, or contextual information about the dosing event (e.g., 'pump cavitation observed', 'manual override due to analyzer failure'). Supports operational audit trail and incident investigation.
attributes.references: Water Utilities O&M Procedures; EPA SDWA Operator Log Requirements

attributes.name: post_dose_residual_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Actual measured residual concentration of the target parameter (e.g., free chlorine residual, pH) after the dosing event. Critical for CT compliance verification, MCL compliance, and dose efficacy reporting in Monthly Operating Reports (MOR).
attributes.references: EPA SDWA 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA M20; MOR Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: pre_dose_residual_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Measured concentration of the target parameter (e.g., chlorine residual, pH) immediately before the dosing event commenced. Provides baseline for dose efficacy assessment and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; AWWA Water Quality Monitoring Standards; LIMS

attributes.name: pump_flow_rate_gpm
attributes.description: The dosing pump flow rate in Gallons per Minute (GPM) during the event, as recorded by SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian via the pump tag. Used for pump calibration verification and dose accuracy auditing.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; SCADA/PLC Operations; AWWA M20

attributes.name: pump_scada_tag
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA tag identifier for the dosing pump instrument (e.g., 'WTP1.PUMP.CL2.FLOW.001'). Enables direct linkage to real-time process data in PI Historian for trend analysis and audit trail verification.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Convention; SCADA/PLC Operations

attributes.name: regulatory_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dosing event is subject to regulatory reporting requirements (True = must be included in MOR, DMR, or CCR submissions). Enables automated filtering of reportable events for EPA and state primacy agency compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; NPDES DMR Reporting; CCR Requirements; State Primacy Agency

attributes.name: target_dose_rate_mg_per_l
attributes.description: The planned or setpoint dose rate in mg/L as configured in the SCADA/PLC control system or operator dosing schedule. Compared against actual dose_rate_mg_per_l to assess dosing accuracy and control loop performance.
attributes.references: SCADA/PLC Setpoint Management; AWWA M20; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: target_residual_mg_per_l
attributes.description: The desired or regulatory-required residual concentration of the target parameter after dosing. Compared against post_dose_residual_mg_per_l to determine compliance status. Derived from MCL/MCLG standards or internal treatment targets.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA MCL/MCLG; 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA Standards

attributes.name: treatment_process_stage
attributes.description: The stage in the water treatment process where the chemical was dosed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_treatment|coagulation|flocculation|sedimentation|filtration|disinfection|post_treatment|distribution — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Water Treatment Plant Design; EPA SDWA Treatment Technique Requirements

attributes.name: turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Water turbidity in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU) at the dosing point during the event. Turbidity affects disinfection efficacy and is a key regulatory parameter under the Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR). Sourced from SCADA or LIMS.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA SWTR; 40 CFR Part 141.73; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: unit_cost_per_kg
attributes.description: The unit cost of the chemical in USD per kilogram at the time of the dosing event, sourced from SAP MM purchase order pricing. Used for chemical cost allocation per dosing event and OPEX analytics. Classified as confidential due to supplier contract pricing sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP ERP MM/FI; GAAP; GASB Utility Accounting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chemical dose event record was last modified, including QA review updates, operator corrections, or regulatory annotation changes. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Water Utilities Data Governance Policy; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: volume_applied_l
attributes.description: Total volume of chemical solution applied during the dosing event, expressed in liters. Used for chemical inventory consumption tracking, cost allocation, and procurement planning in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP ERP MM Module; AWWA Chemical Consumption Tracking

attributes.name: water_flow_rate_mgd
attributes.description: The water flow rate in Million Gallons per Day (MGD) at the dosing point during the event, as recorded by SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian. Used to validate dose rate calculations and for CT compliance verification.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; EPA SDWA CT Compliance; AWWA M20

attributes.name: water_ph
attributes.description: The pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of the water at the dosing point during the event. Critical for CT compliance calculations (CT requirements vary with pH for chlorine disinfection), DBP formation potential, and corrosion control under LCRR.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR); 40 CFR Part 141.72; AWWA

attributes.name: water_temperature_c
attributes.description: Water temperature in degrees Celsius at the dosing point during the event. Critical input for CT compliance calculations (CT requirements vary with temperature) and for chemical reaction rate modeling.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA SWTR CT Tables; 40 CFR Part 141.72; AWWA M20

products.name: ct_compliance_record
products.description: Tracks CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) compliance calculations required under the Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR). Captures CT value calculated (mg/L·min), CT required (based on Giardia/virus log inactivation targets), CT ratio (achieved/required), disinfectant type, temperature, pH, flow rate at time of calculation, compliance status (pass/fail), and reporting period. Critical for MOR regulatory submissions and EPA primacy agency reporting.
products.reference: CT Disinfection Compliance Record (SWTR)

attributes.name: ct_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CT compliance calculation record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete regulatory compliance calculation event with a clear lifecycle under the Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR).
attributes.references: AWWA; U.S. EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: chemical_dose_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.chemical_dose_event. Business justification: CT (Contact Time) compliance is calculated based on the disinfectant concentration achieved by a specific chemical dosing event. Linking ct_compliance_record to the triggering chemical_dose_event prov

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pressure_zone. Business justification: CT compliance is calculated for water entering specific pressure zones. Regulatory requirement: MOR submissions must demonstrate adequate disinfection for each zone served. Different zones have differ

attributes.name: primary_ct_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) or Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) facility where this CT compliance calculation was performed. Links to the facility master record in the asset management domain.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: primary_ct_process_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treatment unit or disinfection contact basin within the WTP where CT was measured (e.g., chlorine contact chamber, UV reactor, ozone contactor). Sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian asset hierarchy or IBM Maximo asset register.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: process_reading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.process_reading. Business justification: CT compliance calculations use real-time SCADA/PI Historian readings for disinfectant concentration and flow rate. ct_compliance_record has pi_tag_concentration and pi_tag_flow as string tag reference

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: CT compliance is calculated for specific disinfection contact chambers (registered assets). SWTR regulatory audit trails require linking CT records to the physical contact chamber asset for asset-leve

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: CT compliance records demonstrate compliance with the Surface Water Treatment Rule — a specific regulatory requirement. ct_compliance_record has ct_table_reference and target_organism as plain text. A

attributes.name: source_water_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.source_water_intake. Business justification: CT compliance requirements under the Surface Water Treatment Rule depend on source water type (surface vs. groundwater), temperature, and turbidity — all captured in source_water_intake. ct_compliance

attributes.name: water_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.water_sample. Business justification: CT compliance calculations (SWTR disinfection) are supported by water samples measuring pH, temperature, and disinfectant concentration. Linking ct_compliance_record to the supporting water_sample pro

attributes.name: baffling_factor
attributes.description: The dimensionless baffling factor (T10/T) applied to the theoretical hydraulic detention time to calculate the effective T10 contact time. Ranges from 0.1 (poor baffling) to 1.0 (plug flow). Determined by tracer study or EPA baffling factor table per SWTR guidance.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR Guidance Manual; AWWA

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to derive the CT compliance calculation. 'scada_automated' = real-time automated calculation from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian; 'manual_grab' = operator-collected grab sample data; 'lims_integrated' = data sourced from LIMS (LabWare); 'pi_historian_batch' = batch calculation from PI Historian archived data.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; OSIsoft PI Historian; LIMS (LabWare)

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the CT compliance calculation was performed or the SCADA/PI Historian data snapshot was captured. Represents the business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor notes regarding this CT compliance calculation, such as unusual operating conditions, equipment anomalies, data quality flags, or explanations for deviations. Supports MOR narrative documentation.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this CT compliance calculation record indicating whether the calculated CT ratio meets regulatory requirements. 'pass' = CT ratio >= 1.0; 'fail' = CT ratio < 1.0 triggering corrective action; 'pending_review' = awaiting operator verification; 'exceedance_reported' = violation reported to primacy agency; 'data_gap' = missing data prevents calculation.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: contact_time_min
attributes.description: The effective hydraulic contact time (T10 — time for 10% of tracer to pass through) in minutes for the disinfection contact basin or reactor at the measured flow rate. T10 is the regulatory-accepted contact time per EPA guidance, accounting for short-circuiting.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA Disinfection Committee

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken or planned in response to a CT compliance failure, such as increasing disinfectant dosage, reducing flow rate, or repairing baffling structures. Populated when corrective_action_required = True.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action plan is required as a result of this CT compliance record (True = corrective action required due to compliance failure; False = no corrective action required). Triggers workflow in IBM Maximo or SAP PM for corrective maintenance or process adjustment.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; IBM Maximo Asset Management; SAP ERP PM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this CT compliance record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ct_calculated
attributes.description: The actual CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) value achieved during the measurement period, expressed in mg/L·min (disinfectant concentration multiplied by contact time). This is the primary quantitative result of the compliance calculation. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian real-time process data.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: ct_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of CT calculated to CT required (ct_calculated / ct_required). A value >= 1.0 indicates compliance (pass); a value < 1.0 indicates a compliance failure. Critical metric for MOR regulatory submissions and EPA primacy agency reporting under SWTR.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: ct_required
attributes.description: The minimum CT value required by regulation to achieve the target log inactivation credit for Giardia lamblia and/or viruses, expressed in mg/L·min. Derived from EPA CT tables based on disinfectant type, temperature, and pH. Used as the denominator in the CT ratio calculation.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Appendix C; AWWA

attributes.name: ct_table_reference
attributes.description: The specific EPA CT table identifier used to determine the required CT value for this calculation (e.g., 'Table C-1 Free Chlorine Giardia', 'Table C-3 Chloramines Virus'). Provides regulatory traceability for the ct_required value and supports MOR documentation.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Appendix C; AWWA

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the raw measurement data for this CT calculation was sourced. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements. 'pi_historian' = OSIsoft PI Historian; 'lims' = LabWare LIMS; 'scada_manual' = SCADA HMI manual entry; 'hmi_entry' = Human Machine Interface direct entry; 'imported' = external data import.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; LIMS (LabWare); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: disinfectant_concentration
attributes.description: The measured residual concentration of the disinfectant at the point of CT measurement, expressed in mg/L. For free chlorine, this is the free chlorine residual; for chloramines, the total chloramine residual. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian or LIMS grab sample results.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: disinfectant_type
attributes.description: The type of primary disinfectant used in the treatment process for this CT calculation. Determines which EPA CT table is applied to derive the required CT value. UV (Ultraviolet Disinfection) is expressed as UV dose (mJ/cm²) rather than concentration-based CT.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA

attributes.name: flow_rate_mgd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flow Rate (MGD — Million Gallons per Day)
attributes.description: The volumetric flow rate through the treatment unit at the time of CT calculation, expressed in MGD (Million Gallons per Day). Flow rate determines the hydraulic contact time and is used to calculate T10 for the disinfection basin. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian flow meters.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: log_inactivation_achieved
attributes.description: The actual log inactivation credit achieved based on the calculated CT value, expressed as a log10 value. Derived from EPA CT tables using disinfectant type, temperature, pH, and ct_calculated. Compared against log_inactivation_required to determine compliance status.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Appendix C; AWWA

attributes.name: log_inactivation_required
attributes.description: The minimum log inactivation credit required by regulation for the target organism at this treatment facility, expressed as a log10 value (e.g., 3.0 for Giardia, 4.0 for viruses). Determined by the primacy agency based on source water quality and treatment technique requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: operator_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the certified operator verified and approved this CT compliance calculation record. Provides audit trail for regulatory defensibility. Null if operator_verified = False. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; ISO 9001

attributes.name: operator_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certified water treatment plant operator has reviewed and verified the accuracy of this CT compliance calculation record (True = verified; False = pending verification). Required for regulatory defensibility of MOR submissions.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: The measured pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of the water at the time of CT calculation. pH affects disinfection efficacy, particularly for free chlorine (hypochlorous acid vs. hypochlorite ion equilibrium), and is a key input to EPA CT tables. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian or LIMS.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: pi_tag_concentration
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag name for the disinfectant concentration measurement used in this CT calculation (e.g., 'WTP01.CL2.RESIDUAL.MGL'). Enables direct traceability from the compliance record back to the source PI Historian time-series data point for audit and verification.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: pi_tag_flow
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag name for the flow rate measurement used in this CT calculation (e.g., 'WTP01.FLOW.INFLUENT.MGD'). Enables direct traceability from the compliance record back to the source PI Historian time-series data point for audit and verification.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: pwsid
attributes.description: The EPA-assigned Public Water System Identifier (PWSID) for the water system submitting this CT compliance record. Format: 2-letter state code followed by 7-digit system number (e.g., 'CA0100001'). Required on all regulatory submissions to EPA and state primacy agencies.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS); SDWA; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this CT compliance calculation record, formatted as CT-{YYYY}-{MM}-{NNNNNN}. Used in Monthly Operating Reports (MOR) and EPA primacy agency submissions to uniquely reference a specific compliance calculation event.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the regulatory reporting period to which this CT compliance record belongs. Together with reporting_period_start, defines the MOR submission window for CT compliance data to the EPA primacy agency.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the regulatory reporting period (typically monthly) to which this CT compliance record belongs. Used for aggregating CT compliance data into Monthly Operating Reports (MOR) and Discharge Monitoring Reports (DMR) submitted to the primacy agency.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: source_water_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source water type subject to SWTR CT requirements. 'surface_water' = direct surface water intake; 'groundwater_under_direct_influence' = GWUDI subject to SWTR; 'purchased_surface' = purchased water from surface water source. Determines applicable CT regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: t10_basis
attributes.description: The method used to establish the T10 hydraulic contact time for the disinfection basin. 'tracer_study' = validated tracer study per EPA guidance; 'baffling_factor' = EPA baffling factor table applied to theoretical detention time; 'cfd_model' = computational fluid dynamics model; 'conservative_estimate' = conservative regulatory default.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR Guidance Manual; AWWA; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: target_organism
attributes.description: The pathogenic organism for which the CT log inactivation credit is being calculated. 'giardia' = Giardia lamblia (3-log inactivation required under SWTR); 'virus' = enteric viruses (4-log inactivation); 'cryptosporidium' = Cryptosporidium parvum (LT2ESWTR); 'combined' = combined credit calculation.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; U.S. EPA LT2ESWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart W

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: The measured water temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of CT calculation. Temperature is a critical parameter in EPA CT tables — lower temperatures require higher CT values to achieve the same log inactivation credit. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Appendix C; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: theoretical_detention_time_min
attributes.description: The theoretical hydraulic detention time (volume / flow rate) of the disinfection contact basin in minutes, before applying the baffling factor to derive T10. Used in conjunction with baffling_factor to calculate contact_time_min.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR Guidance Manual; AWWA

attributes.name: turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: The measured turbidity of the water entering the disinfection stage, expressed in NTU (Nephelometric Turbidity Units). High turbidity can shield pathogens from disinfectants, reducing CT effectiveness. Regulatory trigger: turbidity > 1 NTU may require additional CT credit. Sourced from SCADA/PI Historian or LIMS.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp indicating when this CT compliance record was last modified, such as after operator review, data correction, or status change. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: uv_dose_mj_cm2
attributes.description: The measured UV (Ultraviolet Disinfection) dose delivered by the UV reactor, expressed in mJ/cm² (millijoules per square centimeter). Applicable only when disinfectant_type = 'uv'. UV dose replaces concentration-based CT for UV disinfection compliance under SWTR and LT2ESWTR. Sourced from UV reactor SCADA/PI Historian.
attributes.references: U.S. EPA LT2ESWTR 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart W; AWWA; OSIsoft PI Historian

products.name: filter_run
products.description: Captures complete filter run lifecycle records for granular media, membrane (MF/UF), or GAC filter units, including the terminal backwash event. Records filter unit ID, run start/end timestamps, run duration (hours), volume filtered (MG), initial and terminal head loss (ft), turbidity breakthrough readings (NTU), backwash trigger reason (time, head loss, turbidity), filter-to-waste duration, backwash water volume used (gallons), air scour duration, backwash flow rate (GPM), post-backwash turbidity (NTU), and backwash waste disposal method. Supports filter performance analysis, backwash optimization, backwash water recovery tracking, NRW calculations, and regulatory turbidity compliance.
products.reference: Filter Run Log

attributes.name: filter_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual filter run record in the water treatment process. Primary key for the filter_run data product.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37 – Operational Control of Coagulation and Filtration Processes

attributes.name: backwash_sequence_backwash_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the backwash cycle record that was triggered at the end of this filter run. Links the filter run to its associated backwash event for end-to-end filter cycle analysis and backwash optimization.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; IBM Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Filter media (anthracite, sand, GAC) are consumable inventory items with material numbers, procurement lead times, and replacement schedules. Links filter performance tracking to material master for m

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pressure_zone. Business justification: Filter runs produce water for specific pressure zones. Critical for water quality incident investigation (which zone received water from a filter with turbidity breakthrough) and hydraulic modeling. O

attributes.name: primary_filter_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) or Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) facility where this filter run occurred. Supports multi-facility reporting and regulatory compliance aggregation.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) 40 CFR Part 141; State Primacy Agency reporting

attributes.name: process_reading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.process_reading. Business justification: Filter run performance is monitored via SCADA/PI Historian process readings (turbidity, head loss, flow rate). filter_run captures many inline measurement values (influent_turbidity_ntu, terminal_head

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific filter unit (granular media, membrane MF/UF, or GAC filter) on which this run was executed. Links to the asset management record in IBM Maximo.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Filter runs occur on specific physical filter assets. Operators and regulators (Surface Water Treatment Rule) require linking filter run performance to the asset registry for condition trending, failu

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Filter turbidity requirements are mandated by specific regulations (LT2ESWTR, SWTR). filter_run has regulatory_compliance_flag and turbidity_threshold_ntu as plain text. Linking filter runs to the spe

attributes.name: backwash_trigger_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason that terminated this filter run and initiated a backwash cycle. 'time' indicates the run reached its maximum configured duration; 'head_loss' indicates terminal head loss threshold was reached; 'turbidity_breakthrough' indicates effluent turbidity exceeded the threshold; 'operator_initiated' indicates manual operator decision; 'scheduled' indicates a pre-programmed backwash schedule; 'emergency' indicates an unplanned operational event.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR)

attributes.name: coagulant_dose_mg_l
attributes.description: The coagulant chemical dose applied upstream of the filter during this run, expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Coagulation quality directly impacts filter performance and turbidity removal efficiency. Sourced from chemical dosing SCADA records.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA Enhanced Coagulation Rule; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this filter run record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the audit trail creation timestamp, distinct from the operational run_start_timestamp. Used for data lineage and ETL audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GASB data governance standards

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system from which this filter run record was captured. 'scada_pi_historian' indicates automated capture from OSIsoft PI Historian; 'manual_entry' indicates operator-entered data; 'lims' indicates data sourced from the Laboratory Information Management System; 'hybrid' indicates a combination of automated and manual data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001 Data Quality

attributes.name: days_since_last_backwash
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed since the previous backwash cycle for this filter unit, at the time this run commenced. Used to assess backwash frequency compliance and filter maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; Plant Operations Manual

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_duration_min
attributes.description: Duration in minutes of the filter-to-waste (ripening) phase at the start of this filter run. Null if filter_to_waste_flag is False. Used to optimize ripening time and minimize water loss while ensuring effluent quality compliance.

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a filter-to-waste (ripening) phase was employed at the start of this filter run, diverting initial effluent to waste rather than the distribution system. Filter-to-waste is used to prevent turbidity spikes from entering the treated water supply during the filter ripening period post-backwash.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA LT2ESWTR; AWWA Filter Performance Standards

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_volume_mg
attributes.description: Volume of water in Million Gallons (MG) diverted to waste during the filter-to-waste ripening phase. Contributes to Non-Revenue Water (NRW) calculations and water loss accounting. Null if filter_to_waste_flag is False.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; AWWA Water Loss Control Committee; EPA LT2ESWTR

attributes.name: flow_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Average flow rate through the filter unit during this run, expressed in Gallons Per Minute (GPM). Used to calculate hydraulic loading rate and assess filter performance relative to design capacity.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA integration

attributes.name: head_loss_threshold_ft
attributes.description: The maximum allowable head loss in feet of water column configured for this filter unit, above which a backwash is automatically triggered. Stored per run to capture any threshold changes over time for audit and optimization purposes.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; Plant Operations Manual

attributes.name: hydraulic_loading_rate_gpm_sqft
attributes.description: The hydraulic loading rate applied to the filter during this run, expressed as Gallons Per Minute per square foot of filter surface area. A key operational parameter for filter performance assessment and comparison against AWWA design standards.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; AWWA Filter Design Standards

attributes.name: influent_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Turbidity of the water entering the filter at the start of the run, measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Provides context for filter loading conditions and is used in performance analysis and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141.173; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: initial_effluent_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Turbidity of the filtered water (effluent) at the beginning of the filter run, measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Establishes the baseline effluent quality at run start for performance trending.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141.173; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: initial_head_loss_ft
attributes.description: Differential pressure head loss across the filter media at the start of the filter run, measured in feet of water column. Establishes the baseline for head loss progression monitoring and backwash trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA integration

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the certified water treatment operator to record observations, anomalies, or contextual information about this filter run. Supports operational knowledge capture and regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; State Primacy Agency MOR requirements

attributes.name: particle_count_per_ml
attributes.description: Average particle count in the filter effluent during this run, expressed as particles per milliliter. Particle counting provides a more sensitive measure of filter performance than turbidity alone and is used for Cryptosporidium and Giardia removal credit under the LT2ESWTR.
attributes.references: EPA LT2ESWTR; AWWA Manual M37; AWWA Particle Counting Guidelines

attributes.name: peak_effluent_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: The highest turbidity reading recorded in the filter effluent during the run, measured in NTU. Critical for regulatory compliance — the EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule requires individual filter effluent turbidity not to exceed 1.0 NTU (or 0.3 NTU in 95% of measurements). Triggers turbidity breakthrough alerts.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141.173; EPA LT2ESWTR; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Average pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of the water entering the filter during this run. pH affects coagulation efficiency, disinfection effectiveness, and filter media integrity. Sourced from inline SCADA pH analyzers.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR; AWWA Manual M37; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filter run met all applicable regulatory turbidity and performance requirements under the EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) and LT2ESWTR. False indicates a compliance exceedance event requiring regulatory notification and corrective action documentation.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141; EPA LT2ESWTR; State Primacy Agency requirements

attributes.name: run_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the filter run in hours, from run_start_timestamp to run_end_timestamp. Used for filter performance benchmarking, backwash frequency analysis, and O&M optimization. Populated upon run completion.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; AWWA Filter Performance Standards

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the filter run was terminated (by backwash trigger, time limit, or operator action), as recorded by the SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian system. Null if the run is still in progress.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the filter run, typically assigned by the SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian system or the WTP operations team. Used for cross-referencing with Monthly Operating Reports (MOR) and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: run_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of filter runs for this filter unit since the last media replacement or major rehabilitation. Used to track cumulative filter usage, assess media aging, and plan media replacement schedules.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; IBM Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the filter run commenced, as recorded by the SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the filter run lifecycle. Used for run duration calculation and regulatory CT (Contact Time) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the filter run. 'in_progress' indicates active filtration; 'completed' indicates normal termination; 'aborted' indicates premature termination due to operational issue; 'backwash_initiated' indicates the run ended by triggering a backwash cycle; 'filter_to_waste' indicates the run is in the filter-to-waste phase post-backwash.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR)

attributes.name: scada_tag_prefix
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA tag prefix associated with this filter unit's instrumentation data stream. Enables direct linkage between this filter run record and the corresponding time-series data in the PI Historian for detailed process analytics and audit trail.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA SCADA Security Guidelines

attributes.name: terminal_effluent_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Turbidity of the filter effluent at the end of the run (at backwash trigger or run termination), measured in NTU. Used to assess whether turbidity breakthrough was the cause of run termination and for regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141.173; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: terminal_head_loss_ft
attributes.description: Differential pressure head loss across the filter media at the end of the filter run (at backwash trigger or run termination), measured in feet of water column. Used to assess filter loading and determine if head loss was the backwash trigger. Compared against the head loss threshold to evaluate filter condition.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA integration

attributes.name: toc_effluent_mg_l
attributes.description: Total Organic Carbon (TOC) concentration in the filter effluent during this run, measured in mg/L. Used to calculate TOC removal efficiency across the filter and assess GAC adsorption capacity. Sourced from LIMS or inline TOC analyzers.
attributes.references: EPA Enhanced Surface Water Treatment Rule; EPA Stage 2 DBP Rule; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: toc_influent_mg_l
attributes.description: Total Organic Carbon (TOC) concentration in the filter influent during this run, measured in mg/L. TOC is a key parameter for GAC filter performance assessment and Disinfection Byproduct (DBP) precursor removal tracking. Sourced from LIMS or inline TOC analyzers.
attributes.references: EPA Enhanced Surface Water Treatment Rule; EPA Stage 2 DBP Rule; AWWA Manual M37

attributes.name: turbidity_mcl_exceedance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Turbidity Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) Exceedance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the peak effluent turbidity during this filter run exceeded the regulatory Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) threshold of 1.0 NTU as defined by the EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule. True triggers regulatory notification and MOR documentation requirements.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR Part 141.173; State Primacy Agency reporting requirements

attributes.name: turbidity_threshold_ntu
attributes.description: The effluent turbidity level in NTU configured as the breakthrough trigger for this filter unit. When peak_effluent_turbidity_ntu exceeds this value, a backwash may be triggered. Stored per run to capture threshold configuration at time of run.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; Plant Operations Manual; EPA SWTR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this filter run record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks data corrections, late-arriving SCADA data updates, or operator note additions. Used for data lineage and change audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GASB data governance standards

attributes.name: volume_filtered_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of water processed through the filter unit during this run, expressed in Million Gallons (MG). A key performance indicator for filter throughput and backwash optimization. Sourced from SCADA flow meters integrated with OSIsoft PI Historian.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR)

attributes.name: water_temperature_c
attributes.description: Average temperature of the water being filtered during this run, measured in degrees Celsius. Water temperature affects filter ripening time, head loss development, and biological activity in GAC filters. Sourced from SCADA instrumentation.
attributes.references: AWWA Manual M37; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA integration

products.name: backwash_event
products.description: Records each filter backwash event including filter unit, backwash start/end timestamps, backwash water volume used (gallons), air scour duration, backwash flow rate (GPM), post-backwash turbidity (NTU), backwash waste disposal method, and operator confirmation. Supports backwash water recovery tracking, NRW calculations, and filter media performance trending.
products.reference: Filter Backwash Event Log

attributes.name: backwash_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each filter backwash event record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: backwash_meter_installation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.installation. Business justification: Backwash events record backwash_flow_rate_gpm and backwash_water_volume_gal measured by a dedicated flow meter installation. SWTR/LT2 filter performance reporting and regulatory compliance require tra

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Chemical aids used in filter backwash (polymers, surfactants) are procured materials with inventory tracking requirements. Links backwash chemical consumption to material master for usage-based reorde

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pm_schedule. Business justification: Filter backwash events can be preventive (scheduled time-based or meter-based PM) or reactive (triggered by headloss/turbidity). Operators and asset managers need to distinguish PM-scheduled backwashe

attributes.name: post_backwash_turbidity_reading_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Post Backwash Turbidity Reading Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.turbidity_reading. Business justification: SWTR requires post-backwash turbidity compliance verification before returning a filter to service. Linking backwash_event to the authoritative post-backwash turbidity_reading provides the regulatory

attributes.name: primary_backwash_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) facility where the backwash event occurred. Supports multi-facility reporting and MOR regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA); State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: process_reading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.process_alarm. Business justification: Backwash events may be triggered by process alarms (e.g., high headloss alarm, turbidity breakthrough alarm). The initiation_type and trigger_reason fields indicate whether backwash was alarm-triggere

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific filter unit (filter cell/bed) at the WTP that underwent the backwash event. Links to the filter unit asset record in IBM Maximo CMMS.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Backwash events occur on specific filter assets. SWTR and LT2 regulatory reporting require linking backwash events to the physical filter asset registry entry for performance trending, condition asses

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IBM Maximo CMMS work order associated with this backwash event, enabling O&M cost tracking and maintenance history linkage.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); AWWA M37 Manual

attributes.name: abnormal_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backwash event was flagged as abnormal due to unexpected conditions such as media loss, turbidity exceedance, premature termination, or equipment malfunction (True = abnormal, False = normal). Triggers follow-up investigation workflow.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: air_scour_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the air scour phase of the backwash cycle in minutes. Null if air scour was not used. Supports optimization of combined air-water backwash procedures per AWWA guidelines.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: air_scour_rate_scfm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Air Scour Rate (Standard Cubic Feet Per Minute)
attributes.description: Air flow rate applied during the air scour phase, measured in Standard Cubic Feet Per Minute (SCFM). Null if air scour was not used. Used to verify compliance with design air scour intensity specifications.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: air_scour_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether air scour was employed as part of the backwash cycle (True) or not (False). Air scour enhances filter media cleaning efficiency and is tracked for process optimization and media longevity analysis.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: backwash_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the backwash cycle was completed or terminated, recorded from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian. Used with start timestamp to calculate total backwash duration. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: backwash_flow_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Average flow rate of backwash water through the filter media during the backwash cycle, measured in Gallons Per Minute (GPM). Used to assess backwash effectiveness and compliance with design specifications.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: backwash_flow_rate_max_gpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Backwash Flow Rate (Gallons Per Minute)
attributes.description: Peak flow rate recorded during the backwash cycle in Gallons Per Minute (GPM). Supports detection of hydraulic surges that may damage filter media and comparison against design maximum flow rate.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: backwash_recycle_volume_gal
attributes.description: Volume of backwash waste water recovered and recycled back to the plant headworks for re-treatment, measured in gallons. Null if recycle was not performed. Supports backwash water recovery tracking and NRW reduction reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Filter Backwash Recycling Rule (FBRR); 40 CFR Part 141.76; AWWA M37

attributes.name: backwash_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the backwash cycle was initiated, recorded from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: backwash_waste_disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of backwash waste water and solids. Options include: 'lagoon' (settling lagoon), 'sewer_discharge' (to sanitary sewer), 'recycle_to_head' (recycled to plant headworks), 'dewatering' (mechanical dewatering), 'land_application'. Tracked for NPDES permit compliance and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; 40 CFR Part 122; CWA Section 402; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: backwash_water_source
attributes.description: Source of water used for the backwash cycle. Supports hydraulic capacity planning and ensures backwash water quality meets operational requirements.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: backwash_water_temp_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the backwash water at the time of the backwash event, measured in degrees Celsius. Water temperature affects backwash expansion rate and media cleaning efficiency; used for seasonal performance analysis.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: backwash_water_volume_gal
attributes.description: Total volume of water used during the backwash cycle, measured in gallons. Critical input for Non-Revenue Water (NRW) calculations, backwash water recovery tracking, and operational efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: chemical_aid_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a chemical ripening aid (e.g., polymer or coagulant) was dosed to the filter during the ripening period to accelerate turbidity reduction (True) or not (False). Supports chemical dosing optimization and cost tracking.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; EPA LT2ESWTR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this backwash event record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, sourced from the operational system of record (OSIsoft PI Historian or IBM Maximo). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Standards

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the backwash cycle in minutes, from start to end. Sourced from SCADA historian or calculated at ingestion. Supports filter media performance trending and compliance with AWWA backwash duration guidelines.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: event_reference_number
