attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the backwash event, used in operational logs, MOR submissions, and CMMS work order references. Format: BWE-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the backwash event. 'scheduled' indicates a planned backwash; 'in_progress' indicates active backwash; 'completed' indicates successful completion with operator confirmation; 'aborted' indicates early termination by operator; 'failed' indicates process failure requiring investigation.
attributes.references: AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: filter_media_type
attributes.description: Type of filter media in the filter unit at the time of the backwash event. Supports media-specific backwash protocol compliance and performance benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|anthracite|dual_media|tri_media|gac|membrane — promote to reference product if additional media types are needed]
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; AWWA Filter Media Standards

attributes.name: filter_ripening_duration_min
attributes.description: Time elapsed in minutes between the end of the backwash cycle and the point when the filter was returned to full production service, representing the filter ripening/maturation period. Supports optimization of filter-to-waste procedures and ripening aid chemical dosing.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; EPA Long Term 2 Enhanced Surface Water Treatment Rule (LT2ESWTR)

attributes.name: filter_run_time_prior_hrs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Filter Run Time Prior to Backwash (Hours)
attributes.description: Total hours the filter operated in service since the previous backwash event. Key metric for filter media performance trending, backwash frequency optimization, and detection of premature filter breakthrough.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filter-to-waste procedure was employed during the ripening period (True) or the filter was returned directly to service (False). Filter-to-waste diverts initial filtered water to waste to prevent turbidity spikes from entering the distribution system.
attributes.references: EPA Long Term 2 Enhanced Surface Water Treatment Rule (LT2ESWTR); AWWA M37

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_volume_gal
attributes.description: Volume of water diverted to waste during the filter ripening period, measured in gallons. Null if filter-to-waste was not used. Contributes to total Non-Revenue Water (NRW) and backwash water recovery calculations.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; EPA LT2ESWTR

attributes.name: initiation_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the backwash event was triggered: 'manual' by operator command, 'automatic' by SCADA/PLC logic based on headloss or turbidity threshold, 'scheduled' per routine maintenance plan, or 'emergency' due to abnormal filter performance.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA); AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: media_expansion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage expansion of the filter media bed during the backwash cycle. Optimal expansion (typically 20-50%) ensures effective cleaning without media loss. Supports media performance trending and backwash protocol optimization.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator observations, anomalies, equipment issues, or other contextual information recorded during or after the backwash event. Supports root cause analysis and filter performance investigations.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: operator_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the certified operator formally confirmed the backwash event and authorized filter return to service. Null if operator confirmation is pending. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: operator_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certified water treatment operator formally confirmed the backwash event completion and filter return-to-service (True) or not (False). Required for regulatory accountability and MOR documentation.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; AWWA Operator Certification Standards; EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule

attributes.name: post_backwash_headloss_ft
attributes.description: Differential pressure head loss across the filter media immediately after the backwash cycle completed, measured in feet of water column. Indicates backwash effectiveness; elevated post-backwash headloss may signal media fouling or mudball formation.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: post_backwash_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Filtered water turbidity reading in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU) measured after the backwash cycle and filter ripening period. Critical compliance metric; must meet MCL turbidity limits per EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule before filter is returned to service.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H; AWWA M37; State Drinking Water Programs

attributes.name: pre_backwash_headloss_ft
attributes.description: Differential pressure head loss across the filter media immediately before the backwash cycle began, measured in feet of water column. Primary trigger metric for headloss-initiated backwash events and filter media fouling assessment.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: pre_backwash_turbidity_ntu
attributes.description: Filtered water turbidity reading in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU) immediately before the backwash cycle. Provides baseline filter performance context and supports turbidity-triggered backwash analysis.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; 40 CFR Part 141; AWWA M37

attributes.name: scada_event_tag
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI Historian tag or SCADA event identifier associated with this backwash event, enabling direct traceability to the source process control system record for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA); AWWA SCADA Security Guidance

attributes.name: surface_wash_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a surface wash (rotary or fixed nozzle) was employed as part of the backwash cycle (True) or not (False). Surface wash breaks up surface mud accumulation and is tracked for process optimization.
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; AWWA Filter Backwash Operations Standards

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason that triggered the backwash event. Supports filter performance trending and optimization of backwash frequency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: headloss_threshold|turbidity_threshold|runtime_threshold|scheduled_interval|operator_initiated|emergency — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: AWWA M37 Manual of Water Supply Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian (SCADA)

attributes.name: turbidity_compliance_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post-backwash turbidity reading met the applicable Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) turbidity standard before the filter was returned to service (True = compliant, False = non-compliant). Supports regulatory compliance tracking for MOR submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule; 40 CFR Part 141; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this backwash event record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse, reflecting operator corrections, late data updates, or status changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Standards

products.name: finished_water_production
products.description: Daily and shift-level finished water production records for each WTP. Captures production date, shift, total volume produced (MG), volume pumped to distribution (MG), volume used for plant operations (backwash, filter-to-waste), source water volume intake (MG), plant efficiency ratio, and finished water quality summary (turbidity, chlorine residual, pH, fluoride). Primary record for MOR production reporting and water balance calculations.
products.reference: Finished Water Production Log / MOR Production Data

attributes.name: finished_water_production_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each finished water production record at the Water Treatment Plant (WTP). Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete daily/shift-level production event with a clear lifecycle.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Production records during commissioning/startup track new facility performance against design capacity. Project closeout requires demonstration of design flow rate achievement. Links production data t

attributes.name: ct_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.ct_compliance_record. Business justification: Daily finished water production records include CT compliance metrics (ct_achieved_mg_min_l, ct_required_mg_min_l) inline. These values are authoritatively owned by ct_compliance_record. Adding ct_com

attributes.name: distribution_pump_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pump_station. Business justification: Finished water is pumped into distribution via specific pump stations. Essential for tracking the physical handoff between treatment and distribution, hydraulic modeling, and water quality tracing. Op

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Daily production records drive revenue recognition and are compared against budgeted production volumes. Required for monthly financial close, rate case revenue forecasting, budget variance analysis,

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pressure_zone. Business justification: Finished water production is delivered into specific pressure zones. Critical for hydraulic balance, demand forecasting, NRW analysis, and MOR reporting. Distribution operators must track which zone r

attributes.name: primary_finished_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) facility where this production record was generated. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE / MASTER_RESOURCE reference for TRANSACTION_HEADER role, linking production data to the specific treatment facility. Used for multi-plant production aggregation and facility-level reporting.
attributes.references: AWWA M36; EPA SDWA Facility Registry

attributes.name: production_meter_installation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.installation. Business justification: Finished water production records must reference the master meter installation measuring total plant output for regulatory compliance. MOR/DMR submissions require certified metered production volumes.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_tank_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.storage_tank. Business justification: Daily production balancing and system hydraulics require tracking which distribution storage tank receives finished water output from each WTP production shift. Operators and planners use this link fo

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Finished water production records are associated with clearwells and storage assets (registered assets). Asset-level production tracking enables capital planning, condition-based capacity analysis, an

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production record was approved by the supervising operator for MOR reporting (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements and regulatory submission deadline tracking.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Requirements; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: avg_production_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Average finished water production flow rate during this production period, measured in Gallons per Minute (GPM). Derived from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian flow meter data. Used for hydraulic loading analysis, pump performance monitoring, and comparison against design flow rates.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Operational Best Practices

attributes.name: backwash_volume_mg
attributes.description: Volume of water used specifically for filter backwash operations during this production period, measured in Million Gallons (MG). A sub-component of plant operations water. Tracked separately for filter performance monitoring and optimization of backwash frequency and duration.
attributes.references: AWWA Filter Backwash Recycling Rule; EPA 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H

attributes.name: chemical_dosing_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether any unplanned or emergency chemical dosing event occurred during this production period (True = yes, False = no). Flags records requiring additional review in LIMS or SCADA systems. Supports operational exception reporting and chemical usage variance analysis.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Handling Best Practices; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: cl2_residual_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average free chlorine residual concentration in finished water at the WTP effluent during this production period, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Must meet the minimum residual disinfectant level of 0.2 mg/L at the point of entry to the distribution system. Critical for disinfection compliance and MOR reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR 141.72; SDWA Disinfection Requirements; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: cl2_residual_min_mg_l
attributes.description: Minimum free chlorine residual concentration recorded in finished water during this production period, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Tracked to identify potential disinfection deficiency events. Any reading below 0.2 mg/L triggers regulatory notification requirements.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR 141.72; SDWA 40 CFR Part 141; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality flag indicating the reliability of the production data in this record. 'GOOD' indicates validated sensor/meter data; 'SUSPECT' indicates data that may be erroneous pending investigation; 'ESTIMATED' indicates values estimated due to meter failure or outage; 'MISSING' indicates data gaps; 'CORRECTED' indicates values that have been manually corrected from original readings. Aligns with OSIsoft PI Historian data quality coding conventions.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Quality Codes; ISO 9001 Quality Management; AWWA M36

attributes.name: design_capacity_mgd
attributes.description: Permitted design treatment capacity of the WTP for this production period, measured in Million Gallons per Day (MGD). Captured at the record level to support capacity utilization calculations even if the plant's permitted capacity changes over time. Used for regulatory capacity compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Operating Permit; State Drinking Water Program Capacity Requirements

attributes.name: disinfection_method
attributes.description: Primary disinfection technology used during this production period. 'CHLORINATION' uses free chlorine; 'UV' uses Ultraviolet (UV) disinfection; 'CHLORAMINATION' uses combined chlorine (chloramines); 'OZONATION' uses ozone; 'COMBINED' uses multiple methods. Determines applicable CT requirements and DBP formation potential.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR 141.72; EPA CT Guidance Manual; AWWA Disinfection Best Practices

attributes.name: filter_to_waste_volume_mg
attributes.description: Volume of water discharged to waste during filter ripening (filter-to-waste) operations following backwash, measured in Million Gallons (MG). A sub-component of plant operations water. Tracked for regulatory compliance with turbidity control requirements and water loss accounting.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); AWWA Filter Backwash Recycling Rule

attributes.name: finished_water_volume_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of finished (treated) water produced by the WTP during this production period, measured in Million Gallons (MG). This is the primary production output metric used in MOR reporting, water balance calculations, and capacity utilization analysis. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian clearwell/effluent flow meters.
attributes.references: AWWA M36; EPA MOR Reporting Requirements; SDWA 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: fluoride_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average fluoride concentration in finished water during this production period, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). The EPA Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) for fluoride is 4.0 mg/L; the secondary standard is 2.0 mg/L. The optimal fluoridation level recommended by HHS is 0.7 mg/L. Reported in MOR and Consumer Confidence Report (CCR).
attributes.references: EPA SDWA MCL 40 CFR 141.62; HHS Fluoride Recommendation; EPA CCR Rule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor notes related to this production record. Used to document unusual operating conditions, equipment issues, source water quality events, regulatory exceedances, or other contextual information relevant to MOR reporting and operational review.
attributes.references: AWWA Operational Best Practices; EPA MOR Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: peak_production_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous finished water production flow rate recorded during this production period, measured in Gallons per Minute (GPM). Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian. Used for peak demand analysis, pump sizing validation, and hydraulic capacity planning.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; Innovyze InfoWater Hydraulic Modeling; AWWA M31

attributes.name: ph_avg
attributes.description: Average pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of finished water at the WTP effluent during this production period. Optimal range is typically 7.0–8.5 for corrosion control compliance under the Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR). Critical for disinfection effectiveness (CT compliance) and distribution system corrosion control.
attributes.references: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) 40 CFR 141.82; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: plant_efficiency_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of finished water volume produced to source water volume intake, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9250 = 92.50% efficiency). Calculated as finished_water_volume_mg / source_water_volume_mg. A key operational Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for WTP performance benchmarking and water loss identification. Stored as a raw ratio to support analytics without recalculation.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; AWWA QualServe Benchmarking

attributes.name: plant_ops_water_volume_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of finished water consumed for internal plant operations during this production period, measured in Million Gallons (MG). Includes filter backwash water, filter-to-waste volumes, and other in-plant process uses. Used in water balance accounting and plant efficiency calculations.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the finished water production occurred (yyyy-MM-dd). The principal real-world event date for this production record. Used as the primary time dimension for MOR reporting, water balance calculations, and daily production trend analysis. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Requirements; AWWA M36; SDWA 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: production_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this production record, used in Monthly Operating Reports (MOR) and regulatory submissions. Format: WTP-PRD-YYYY-MM-DD-SHIFT. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EPA MOR Reporting Requirements; AWWA M36

attributes.name: production_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production record workflow. 'draft' indicates data entry in progress; 'submitted' indicates sent for supervisor review; 'approved' indicates validated and accepted for MOR reporting; 'rejected' indicates returned for correction; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a corrected record. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EPA Monthly Operating Report (MOR) Guidelines; SDWA 40 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: regulatory_exceedance
attributes.description: Indicates whether any water quality parameter exceeded its Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) or treatment technique requirement during this production period (True = exceedance occurred, False = all parameters within limits). Triggers mandatory regulatory notification and public notice requirements under SDWA.
attributes.references: SDWA 40 CFR Part 141; EPA Public Notification Rule 40 CFR Part 141 Subpart Q

attributes.name: scada_data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the primary data source for the volumetric and quality measurements in this production record. 'PI_HISTORIAN' indicates automated ingestion from OSIsoft PI Historian; 'MANUAL_ENTRY' indicates operator-entered data; 'SCADA_DCS' indicates direct SCADA/DCS system feed; 'AMI' indicates Advanced Metering Infrastructure; 'HYBRID' indicates a combination of automated and manual sources. Supports data lineage and quality confidence scoring.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; SCADA Best Practices; ISO 9001 Data Quality

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Operational shift during which this production record applies. 'DAY' typically covers 06:00–14:00, 'EVENING' covers 14:00–22:00, 'NIGHT' covers 22:00–06:00, and 'FULL_DAY' represents a consolidated 24-hour daily record. Used for shift-level production analysis and operator accountability.
attributes.references: AWWA Operational Best Practices; OSIsoft PI Historian Shift Reporting

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the production shift ended (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to precisely bound the production measurement window for SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian data integration and shift-level volume reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Operational Best Practices

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the production shift began (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to precisely bound the production measurement window for SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian data integration and shift-level volume reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA Operational Best Practices

attributes.name: source_water_volume_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of raw source water drawn into the WTP during this production period, measured in Million Gallons (MG). Used as the input denominator for plant efficiency ratio calculations and water balance accounting. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian intake flow meters.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: temperature_avg_c
attributes.description: Average temperature of finished water at the WTP effluent during this production period, measured in degrees Celsius (°C). Temperature affects disinfection Contact Time (CT) calculations, chlorine decay rates, and distribution system water quality. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian.
attributes.references: EPA CT Guidance Manual for Disinfection; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: toc_avg_mg_l
attributes.description: Average Total Organic Carbon (TOC) concentration in finished water during this production period, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). TOC is a precursor to Disinfection Byproducts (DBPs) including Trihalomethanes (THMs) and Haloacetic Acids (HAA5). Monitored for Stage 2 Disinfectants and Disinfection Byproducts Rule (DBPR) compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Stage 2 DBPR 40 CFR 141.620; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: treatment_process_type
attributes.description: Primary treatment process technology employed at the WTP for this production record. 'CONVENTIONAL' includes coagulation/flocculation/sedimentation/filtration; 'DIRECT_FILTRATION' omits sedimentation; 'MEMBRANE' includes Reverse Osmosis (RO), Ultrafiltration (UF), or Microfiltration (MF); 'SOFTENING' includes lime softening; 'GROUNDWATER' includes well-based supply with disinfection only.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Treatment Technique Requirements; AWWA Treatment Technology Guidance

attributes.name: turbidity_avg_ntu
attributes.description: Average turbidity of finished water measured at the WTP effluent during this production period, in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). Must comply with the Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) maximum of 0.3 NTU in 95% of monthly samples. Primary finished water quality summary metric for MOR reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR) 40 CFR 141.173; AWWA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: turbidity_max_ntu
attributes.description: Maximum turbidity value recorded in finished water at the WTP effluent during this production period, in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). The regulatory Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) for turbidity is 1 NTU. Tracked separately from average to identify peak exceedance events for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR 40 CFR 141.173; SDWA MCL Requirements; EPA MOR Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production record was last modified (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks data corrections and supervisor approvals.

attributes.name: volume_pumped_to_distribution_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of finished water pumped from the WTP clearwell into the distribution network during this production period, measured in Million Gallons (MG). Distinct from finished water produced — the difference represents storage changes. Critical for water balance and Non-Revenue Water (NRW) calculations.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits and Loss Control Programs; EPA MOR Reporting

products.name: source_water_intake
products.description: Records raw water intake events from surface water or groundwater sources. Captures intake date/time, source water body or well ID, volume withdrawn (MG), raw water quality parameters at intake (turbidity NTU, TOC mg/L, temperature, pH, conductivity, algae count), intake pump station ID, withdrawal permit limit, and compliance status. Supports source water protection program and intake optimization.
products.reference: Source Water Intake Record

attributes.name: source_water_intake_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each source water intake event record in the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) operations system. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Intake structures are delivered via capital projects. Required for asset capitalization, linking intake permits to construction permits, tracking intake improvements, and connecting as-built drawings

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.construction_contract. Business justification: Source water intake structures are built or rehabilitated under construction contracts. Warranty claims, defect liability periods, and contractor performance tracking require linking each intake asset

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Raw water acquisition and intake operations (pumping energy, screening, raw water purchase agreements) are discrete O&M budget line items. Budget officers track actual intake volumes and costs against

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant. Business justification: EPA Drinking Water SRF and watershed protection grants are tied to specific intake locations and source water protection programs. Grant administrators and auditors require the intake-to-grant link to

attributes.name: intake_meter_installation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.installation. Business justification: Source water intake events reference the meter installation at the intake point measuring raw water withdrawal volumes. Withdrawal permits require metered intake volumes for compliance tracking. Water

attributes.name: intake_pump_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the pump station asset through which raw water was drawn from the source. Links to the asset/facility master record managed in IBM Maximo CMMS.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; AWWA M44 Distribution Network

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.process_unit. Business justification: Raw water intake events feed into specific treatment process units (e.g., raw water screening, pre-sedimentation, raw water storage). source_water_intake currently links to facility but not to the spe

attributes.name: raw_water_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.water_sample. Business justification: Source water intake events require raw water quality samples (turbidity, TOC, pH, algae) for source water assessment reporting and treatment optimization decisions. Role prefix 'raw_water_' distinguis

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Intake structures (screens, gates, pumps) are registered assets. Linking intake events to the asset registry enables maintenance scheduling, condition assessment correlation, and capital planning for

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Source water intake monitoring is mandated by specific regulations (source water assessment rules, withdrawal permit requirements). source_water_intake has permit_compliance_status as a denormalized p

attributes.name: source_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) that received the raw water intake. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; AWWA M48; SAP ERP PM Module

attributes.name: source_wtp_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the Water Treatment Plant (WTP) that received the raw water intake. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; AWWA M48; SAP ERP PM Module

attributes.name: storage_tank_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.storage_tank. Business justification: In some configurations, raw water intake pumps directly to distribution storage tanks (common in smaller systems or emergency interconnections). Operators track which tank received raw water for blend

attributes.name: treatment_permit_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the regulatory water withdrawal permit under which this intake event was authorized. Links to the permit master record for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; CWA Section 404

attributes.name: water_source_id
attributes.description: Identifier referencing the specific raw water source body or groundwater well from which water was withdrawn. Links to the water source master record (e.g., river, reservoir, aquifer, well).
attributes.references: EPA Source Water Protection Program; SDWA Section 1453; Esri ArcGIS GIS

attributes.name: algae_count_cells_per_ml
attributes.description: Algae cell count in raw water at intake, measured in cells per milliliter (cells/mL). Elevated algae counts indicate potential for taste and odor issues, cyanotoxin presence, and increased treatment chemical demand. Triggers source water protection alerts and treatment process modifications.
attributes.references: EPA Cyanotoxin Guidance; AWWA M57 Algae; LIMS LabWare; State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: conductivity_us_per_cm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Raw Water Conductivity (µS/cm) - Microsiemens per Centimeter
attributes.description: Electrical conductivity of raw water at intake, measured in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm). Serves as a proxy indicator for Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) concentration and overall ionic strength of the source water. Used to assess suitability for treatment processes such as Reverse Osmosis (RO).
attributes.references: AWWA M48; EPA Secondary Drinking Water Standards; LIMS LabWare

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this source water intake record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GASB; EPA Data Quality Objectives; AWWA M48

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assurance flag indicating the reliability and validation status of the intake event data. 'validated' indicates data has passed QA/QC review; 'provisional' indicates data is pending final validation; 'suspect' indicates potential measurement anomaly requiring investigation; 'invalid' indicates data has been rejected; 'estimated' indicates values were estimated.
attributes.references: EPA Data Quality Objectives (DQO); AWWA M48; ISO 9001 Quality Management; OSIsoft PI Historian Data Quality

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or method by which the intake event data was captured. 'scada_pi_historian' indicates automated capture from OSIsoft PI Historian; 'manual_entry' indicates operator-entered data; 'lims' indicates data sourced from the Laboratory Information Management System; 'estimated' indicates values were estimated due to meter failure.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; LIMS LabWare; AWWA M48; EPA Data Quality Objectives

attributes.name: dissolved_oxygen_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Dissolved oxygen concentration in raw water at intake, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Indicates biological health of the source water body and potential for anaerobic conditions that can release iron, manganese, and hydrogen sulfide, affecting treatment requirements.
attributes.references: EPA CWA Water Quality Standards; AWWA M48; LIMS LabWare

attributes.name: flow_rate_gpm
attributes.description: Average flow rate of raw water intake during the event, expressed in Gallons Per Minute (GPM). Captured from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian flow meter readings at the intake pump station. Used for hydraulic modeling and pump performance analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA M48; Innovyze InfoWater Hydraulic Modeling

attributes.name: gis_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the raw water intake point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for spatial analysis, GIS mapping of intake locations, and source water protection zone delineation in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS; AWWA M48; EPA Source Water Assessment Program

attributes.name: gis_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the raw water intake point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for spatial analysis, GIS mapping of intake locations, and source water protection zone delineation in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS; AWWA M48; EPA Source Water Assessment Program

attributes.name: intake_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the raw water intake event concluded. Used with intake_timestamp to calculate duration and total volume withdrawn during the event.

attributes.name: intake_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the intake event, used in operational logs, regulatory submissions, and Monthly Operating Reports (MOR). Format: SWI-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: AWWA M48; EPA SDWA Section 1453 Source Water Protection

attributes.name: intake_method
attributes.description: Method by which raw water was conveyed from the source to the treatment facility. 'gravity' indicates flow by gravity through an intake channel or conduit; 'pumped' indicates mechanical pumping; 'combined' indicates both methods; 'emergency_bypass' indicates use of an emergency intake route.
attributes.references: AWWA M48; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA

attributes.name: intake_screen_condition
attributes.description: Operational condition of the intake screening equipment (bar screens, traveling screens) at the time of the intake event. Blocked or bypassed screens affect flow rates and may allow debris into the treatment process, impacting downstream equipment and water quality.
attributes.references: AWWA M48; IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: intake_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intake event record. 'active' indicates intake is in progress; 'completed' indicates the event concluded normally; 'suspended' indicates intake was halted due to quality or operational issue; 'cancelled' indicates the event was voided; 'pending_review' indicates the record requires quality assurance review.
attributes.references: AWWA M48; EPA SDWA Source Water Assessment

attributes.name: intake_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world date and time at which the raw water intake event commenced, as recorded by the SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian system at the intake pump station. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; AWWA M48; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: mor_reporting_period
attributes.description: The regulatory Monthly Operating Report (MOR) reporting period (YYYY-MM) to which this intake event belongs. Used to aggregate intake volumes and quality data for submission to State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA; State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; MOR Regulatory Submission Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the plant operator regarding the intake event, including any anomalies, equipment issues, unusual source water conditions, or actions taken. Supports operational log requirements and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: AWWA M48; EPA SDWA Operator Log Requirements; State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: number_of_pumps_active
attributes.description: Count of intake pumps operating simultaneously during the intake event. Used for energy consumption analysis, pump performance benchmarking, and maintenance scheduling in IBM Maximo CMMS.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS; AWWA M44; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: permit_daily_limit_mg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permit Daily Withdrawal Limit (MG) - Million Gallons
attributes.description: Maximum daily volume of raw water authorized for withdrawal under the applicable water withdrawal permit, expressed in Million Gallons (MG). Used to assess compliance status against actual volume withdrawn.
attributes.references: State Drinking Water Programs and Primacy Agencies; EPA SDWA; CWA

attributes.name: ph_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Raw Water pH (Potential of Hydrogen) Level
attributes.description: pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of raw water at the point of intake, measured on the standard 0-14 scale. Influences coagulation efficiency, disinfection effectiveness, and corrosion control treatment. Monitored per Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR); AWWA M48; LIMS LabWare; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: pump_station_operating_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pump Station Operating Pressure (PSI) - Pounds per Square Inch
attributes.description: Operating pressure at the intake pump station during the intake event, measured in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI). Monitored via SCADA to ensure pumps operate within design parameters and to detect potential main breaks or pressure anomalies.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA; AWWA M44; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: raw_water_color_cpu
attributes.description: Apparent color of raw water at intake, measured in Color Units (CPU) using the platinum-cobalt standard. High color values indicate elevated natural organic matter (NOM) and humic substances, which are precursors to Disinfection Byproducts (DBP) including Trihalomethanes (THM) and Haloacetic Acids (HAA5).
attributes.references: EPA Stage 2 DBPR; AWWA M48; LIMS LabWare; Standard Methods for Examination of Water and Wastewater

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the raw water source type. Determines applicable treatment processes, regulatory monitoring requirements, and source water assessment protocols under SDWA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: surface_water|groundwater|purchased_water|recycled_water|brackish_water|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Section 1453; AWWA M48; State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: source_water_alert_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active source water quality alert or advisory was in effect at the time of this intake event (e.g., algal bloom advisory, upstream contamination notice, drought restriction). When True, triggers enhanced monitoring protocols and treatment process review.
attributes.references: EPA Source Water Protection Program; AWWA M48; State Primacy Agencies

attributes.name: source_water_protection_zone
attributes.description: Designation of the source water protection zone or wellhead protection area associated with this intake point, as defined in the utility's Source Water Assessment and Protection (SWAP) program. Used for land use management and contamination risk assessment.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Section 1453 Source Water Protection; State Primacy Agencies; Esri ArcGIS GIS

attributes.name: tds_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) concentration of raw water at intake, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Indicates overall mineral content and salinity of the source water. Drives decisions on treatment technology selection including Reverse Osmosis (RO) and ion exchange.
attributes.references: EPA Secondary Drinking Water Standards (SMCL); AWWA M48; LIMS LabWare

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of raw water at the point of intake, measured in degrees Celsius. Affects disinfection Contact Time (CT) calculations, chemical dosing rates, biological activity, and seasonal treatment process adjustments.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); AWWA M48; OSIsoft PI Historian SCADA

attributes.name: toc_mg_per_l
attributes.description: Total Organic Carbon (TOC) concentration of raw water at intake, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L). Critical parameter for predicting Disinfection Byproduct (DBP) formation potential including Trihalomethanes (THM) and Haloacetic Acids (HAA5). Drives treatment process adjustments.
attributes.references: EPA Stage 2 Disinfectants and Disinfection Byproducts Rule (Stage 2 DBPR); EPA Enhanced Coagulation Rule; AWWA M48; LIMS LabWare

attributes.name: turbidity_ntu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Raw Water Turbidity (NTU) - Nephelometric Turbidity Units
attributes.description: Turbidity of raw water at the point of intake, measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU). A key raw water quality parameter that drives coagulation chemical dosing decisions and treatment process optimization. Captured at intake via inline turbidimeter or LIMS sample.
attributes.references: EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule (SWTR); AWWA M37; LIMS LabWare; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this source water intake record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Tracks data corrections, QA/QC updates, and regulatory review amendments. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GASB; EPA Data Quality Objectives; AWWA M48

attributes.name: upstream_event_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any known upstream events or conditions that may affect raw water quality at the time of intake (e.g., upstream spill, agricultural runoff, upstream WWTP discharge, construction activity). Supports source water protection program documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Source Water Assessment Program (SWAP); AWWA M48; SDWA Section 1453

attributes.name: volume_withdrawn_mg
attributes.description: Total volume of raw water withdrawn during the intake event, expressed in Million Gallons (MG). This is the principal quantitative measurement for the intake event, used for permit compliance, production planning, and Non-Revenue Water (NRW) calculations.
attributes.references: AWWA M36 Water Audits; EPA SDWA; State Withdrawal Permit Conditions

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the time of the intake event. Weather conditions significantly influence raw water quality parameters (turbidity spikes during storm events, algae blooms during drought/heat). Used for source water quality trend analysis and treatment process correlation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|heavy_rain|storm|snow|drought|flood_event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA M48 Source Water Protection; EPA Source Water Assessment Program (SWAP)

products.name: chemical_inventory
products.description: Tracks on-site chemical inventory levels at each treatment facility. Captures chemical name, CAS number, storage tank or container ID, current quantity on hand (lbs/gallons), unit of measure, reorder point, maximum storage capacity, last delivery date, last physical count date, and safety data sheet (SDS) reference. Supports chemical procurement planning, OSHA Tier II reporting, and treatment process continuity.
products.reference: Chemical Inventory / OSHA Tier II Chemical Storage

attributes.name: chemical_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each chemical inventory record in the water treatment facility. Primary key for the chemical_inventory data product.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; AWWA Chemical Handling Standards

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Chemical inventory replenishment is directly triggered by AP invoices from chemical suppliers. The three-way match process (PO → chemical receipt → AP invoice) requires linking inventory records to th

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the water treatment or wastewater treatment plant (WTP/WWTP) where this chemical inventory record is maintained. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: AWWA M20 Water Treatment Plant Design; EPA SDWA Facility Registry

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Chemical inventory is a balance sheet asset (unit_cost and quantity_on_hand present). Required for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, financial statement preparation, and GL posting to inventory a

attributes.name: inventory_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_stock. Business justification: Water utilities must reconcile treatment-domain chemical inventory (with regulatory attributes: EPCRA, RMP, Tier II) against supply-domain warehouse stock records. This link enables chemical stock rec

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Treatment chemicals (chlorine, alum, polymer, caustic) are materials with ERP material numbers, procurement specifications, and inventory management requirements. Fundamental link between treatment ch

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.process_unit. Business justification: chemical_inventory has a dosing_point STRING column identifying where the chemical is applied. This is a free-text reference to a treatment process unit (e.g., 'Pre-chlorination', 'Post-filtration').

attributes.name: storage_asset_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Chemical inventory management requires precise physical location tracking within facilities for safety compliance (EPCRA Tier II reporting), emergency response planning, and operational logistics. Sto

attributes.name: storage_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Chemical storage tanks and containment structures are registered assets requiring condition assessment, RMP/PSM secondary containment inspections, and maintenance scheduling. Role-prefixed 'storage_as

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.vendor

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage tank, container, or designated storage area within the facility where the chemical is stored. Used for precise physical location tracking and OSHA Tier II reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management; OSHA Tier II Reporting

attributes.name: average_daily_usage
attributes.description: Average quantity of the chemical consumed per day at the facility, expressed in the designated unit of measure. Calculated from historical dosing records and used to estimate days of supply remaining and optimize reorder frequency.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Dosing Best Practices; SAP MM Consumption-Based Planning

attributes.name: avg_quantity_in_year
attributes.description: Average daily quantity of the chemical present at the facility during the Tier II reporting year, expressed in the designated unit of measure. Required field for OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II annual report submission.
attributes.references: EPA EPCRA Section 312; 40 CFR Part 370 Tier II Reporting

attributes.name: chemical_code
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.chemical. Business justification: Chemical inventory should reference the chemical master table for authoritative chemical properties (NSF certification, regulatory status, dose limits, storage requirements). The chemical_inventory ta

attributes.name: container_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier or tag number assigned to the specific storage tank or container holding this chemical (e.g., T-101, DRUM-045). Used for physical asset tracking, maintenance records in IBM Maximo, and OSHA Tier II site maps.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management; OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II; AWWA Chemical Safety

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Estimated number of days the current quantity on hand will last based on average daily usage. Provides an operational indicator for procurement urgency and treatment process continuity risk management.
attributes.references: AWWA Water Treatment Resilience; SAP MM Inventory Analytics

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified expiration or shelf-life date for the chemical lot. Chemicals used beyond expiration may degrade in efficacy, impacting treatment performance and regulatory compliance. Triggers disposal or replacement workflows.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Standards; EPA SDWA Treatment Technique Requirements

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT hazardous materials classification code for the chemical (e.g., Class 8 Corrosive, Class 2.3 Toxic Gas, Class 5.1 Oxidizer). Required for transportation compliance, emergency response planning, and OSHA Tier II reporting.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA EPCRA Section 312; GHS

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chemical inventory record indicating whether the chemical is actively in use, on order, depleted, quarantined due to quality concerns, expired, or discontinued from use at the facility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Management; IBM Maximo Asset Management; AWWA Chemical Handling

attributes.name: is_epcra_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical meets the threshold quantity for mandatory reporting under EPCRA Section 312 (Tier II) to state and local emergency planning committees. True if the chemical is an Extremely Hazardous Substance (EHS) or meets reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: EPA EPCRA Section 311-312; 40 CFR Part 370 Tier II Reporting

attributes.name: is_rmp_regulated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Management Program (RMP) Regulated Substance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical is a regulated substance under EPA Risk Management Program (RMP) rules (40 CFR Part 68). True if the chemical is listed and stored above the threshold quantity, requiring an RMP plan submission.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 68 Risk Management Program; Clean Air Act Section 112(r)

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent chemical delivery received at the facility. Used to track supply chain cadence, validate inventory levels, and support procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt; AWWA Chemical Procurement Best Practices

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or verification performed at the storage location. Required for inventory accuracy audits and OSHA Tier II annual reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II Annual Reporting; SAP MM Physical Inventory

attributes.name: last_physical_count_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity recorded during the most recent physical inventory count, expressed in the designated unit of measure. Used to reconcile system quantity against physical stock and identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: SAP MM Physical Inventory; OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier-assigned lot or batch number for the chemical delivery. Enables traceability for quality incidents, product recalls, and treatment process investigations.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Quality Standards; ANSI/AWWA B-Series Chemical Standards

attributes.name: max_quantity_in_year
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of the chemical present at the facility at any point during the Tier II reporting year, expressed in the designated unit of measure. Required field for OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II annual report submission.
attributes.references: EPA EPCRA Section 312; 40 CFR Part 370 Tier II Reporting

attributes.name: max_storage_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum allowable quantity of the chemical that can be stored at the facility location, expressed in the designated unit of measure. Governed by OSHA PSM thresholds, EPA RMP requirements, and local fire codes. Used for OSHA Tier II reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; EPA 40 CFR Part 68 RMP; OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II

attributes.name: maximo_item_number
attributes.description: Item number assigned to this chemical in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS) storeroom inventory. Enables cross-referencing between the lakehouse chemical inventory and the operational CMMS for work order material consumption tracking.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS; AWWA O&M Best Practices

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Hazard Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 flammability hazard rating for the chemical on a scale of 0 (will not burn) to 4 (extremely flammable). Used for fire safety planning, storage segregation requirements, and emergency response.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for Identification of Hazards; OSHA HazCom

attributes.name: nfpa_health_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Health Hazard Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 health hazard rating for the chemical on a scale of 0 (minimal hazard) to 4 (deadly). Used for emergency response planning, worker safety training, and facility hazard communication.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for Identification of Hazards; OSHA HazCom

attributes.name: nfpa_reactivity_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Reactivity Hazard Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 instability/reactivity hazard rating for the chemical on a scale of 0 (stable) to 4 (may detonate). Critical for chemical storage segregation, incompatibility management, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for Identification of Hazards; OSHA HazCom

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with the most recent or active procurement of this chemical. Supports procurement traceability and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order; GAAP Procurement Accounting

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the chemical available in storage at the facility, expressed in the designated unit of measure (lbs or gallons). Updated after each delivery receipt and physical count. Critical for treatment process continuity and procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Management; AWWA Chemical Inventory Best Practices

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chemical inventory record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; GASB Statement 34 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this chemical inventory record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standard; GASB Statement 34 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold at which a replenishment purchase order should be triggered to prevent stockout and ensure uninterrupted treatment operations. Expressed in the same unit of measure as quantity_on_hand.
attributes.references: SAP MM MRP Reorder Point Planning; AWWA Chemical Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer quantity of chemical maintained above the reorder point to protect against supply chain disruptions, delivery delays, or unexpected demand spikes. Expressed in the same unit of measure as quantity_on_hand.
attributes.references: SAP MM Safety Stock Planning; AWWA Water Treatment Resilience Guidelines

attributes.name: sap_material_number
attributes.description: SAP ERP material master number assigned to this chemical in the MM module. Enables traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and SAP procurement, goods receipt, and inventory management transactions.
attributes.references: SAP ERP MM Material Master; GAAP Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: sds_reference_number
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this chemical, as required by OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom). Links to the SDS document management system for emergency response and worker safety.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom); GHS SDS Format

attributes.name: sds_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most current revision of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) on file for this chemical. OSHA requires SDS documents to be current; outdated SDS may indicate a compliance gap.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; GHS Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: storage_container_type
attributes.description: Type of storage vessel or container used to hold the chemical at the facility (e.g., bulk tank, day tank, drum, cylinder, tote, bag). Relevant for spill response planning, OSHA Tier II, and maintenance scheduling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_tank|day_tank|drum|cylinder|tote|bag|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II; AWWA Chemical Storage Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature for the chemical in degrees Celsius, as specified in the SDS. Exceeding this threshold may cause chemical degradation, hazardous reactions, or loss of treatment efficacy.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 SDS Section 7; GHS Storage Requirements

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature for the chemical in degrees Celsius, as specified in the SDS. Ensures chemical integrity and prevents hazardous reactions due to improper storage conditions.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 SDS Section 7; GHS Storage Requirements

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned part or catalog number for this chemical product as used in purchase orders and delivery documentation. Facilitates accurate procurement and receiving.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; AWWA Chemical Procurement

attributes.name: tier2_reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this chemical inventory record is applicable for OSHA EPCRA Section 312 Tier II annual hazardous chemical inventory reporting. Supports annual regulatory submission to state and local emergency planning committees.
attributes.references: EPA EPCRA Section 312; 40 CFR Part 370; OSHA Tier II Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of measure for the chemical as established in the most recent purchase order or contract. Used for chemical cost tracking, OPEX budgeting, and treatment cost-per-gallon calculations. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Accounting; GAAP; GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure used to quantify the chemical inventory (e.g., lbs for dry chemicals, gallons for liquid chemicals). Must be consistent with procurement orders and dosing calculations.
attributes.references: AWWA Chemical Standards; SAP MM Unit of Measure Configuration

products.name: process_control_setpoint
products.description: Master configuration of process control setpoints for treatment process units. Captures setpoint parameter name (chlorine residual target, pH target, turbidity alarm threshold, filter run time limit, chemical dose rate), setpoint value, engineering unit, high/low alarm limits, high/high and low/low trip limits, effective date, approved-by operator, and associated SCADA tag. Provides the authoritative setpoint register for process control and regulatory compliance.
products.reference: Process Control Setpoint Register

attributes.name: process_control_setpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each process control setpoint record in the treatment domain. Primary key for the process_control_setpoint data product.
attributes.references: AWWA Process Control Standards; OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Registry

attributes.name: chemical_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.chemical. Business justification: Process control setpoints for chemical dosing (chlorine residual target, coagulant dose rate, pH adjustment) are specific to a particular chemical. process_control_setpoint has parameter_type (STRING)

attributes.name: contaminant_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.contaminant_limit. Business justification: Operators set process control setpoints (chlorine residual targets, turbidity alarm thresholds) based on regulatory contaminant limits. Links operational setpoint to regulatory driver for compliance-d

attributes.name: pi_point_id
attributes.description: The unique PI Point identifier in the OSIsoft PI Historian system corresponding to this setpoint's SCADA tag. Used for direct data retrieval and synchronization between the Silver Layer setpoint register and the PI Historian real-time data store.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian PI Point Naming Convention; AWWA SCADA Integration

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pm_schedule. Business justification: Setpoint adjustments frequently follow preventive maintenance activities (instrument calibration, control loop tuning, sensor replacement). Water treatment operators need to track which PM events trig

attributes.name: pressure_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pressure_zone. Business justification: Treatment process control setpoints (chlorine residual targets, flow rate limits) are zone-specific — operators configure different target residuals for each pressure zone served. Regulatory complianc

attributes.name: previous_setpoint_process_control_setpoint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding version of this setpoint record (self-referential). Enables reconstruction of the full setpoint change history chain for regulatory audit and process optimization analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: primary_process_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Treatment Plant (WTP) / Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Facility ID
attributes.description: Reference to the treatment facility (WTP or WWTP) where this setpoint is configured and enforced. Links the setpoint to its operational site.
attributes.references: AWWA M56 Fundamentals and Control of Nitrification; EPA SDWA Facility Registry

attributes.name: primary_process_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific treatment process unit (e.g., filter unit, clarifier, chlorination contact chamber, RO train, UV reactor) to which this setpoint applies.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS) Asset Registry; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Control setpoints are configured for specific physical instruments and assets (chlorine analyzers, flow meters). Linking setpoints to the asset registry enables change management audits, calibration t

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Process control setpoints (chlorine residual alarms, turbidity trip limits) are established to ensure compliance with specific MCLs and treatment technique requirements. process_control_setpoint has r

attributes.name: treatment_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.treatment_permit. Business justification: Process control setpoints are governed by regulatory permit limits (e.g., turbidity limit, chlorine residual limit). The permit_number string on process_control_setpoint should be replaced by FK to th

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IBM Maximo work order that authorized or triggered this setpoint change (e.g., a preventive maintenance work order for filter media replacement that requires a setpoint adjustment). Null if the setpoint change was not associated with a maintenance work order.
attributes.references: IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS); SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: alarm_delay_seconds
attributes.description: The time delay in seconds before an alarm is activated after the process variable crosses an alarm limit. Prevents nuisance alarms from transient spikes. A value of 0 means immediate alarm activation.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: The priority classification of alarms generated when this setpoint's limits are breached. 'critical' alarms require immediate operator response and may trigger automatic shutdown; 'high' requires prompt response; 'medium' and 'low' are advisory. Aligns with ISA-18.2 alarm management philosophy.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA Process Control; SCADA HMI Design Standards

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the setpoint was formally approved by the certified operator (referenced by operator_id). Required for regulatory audit trails demonstrating that setpoint changes were authorized by a qualified operator.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Operator Certification; State Primacy Agency Rules; ISO 9001

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business or operational reason for creating or modifying this setpoint record (e.g., 'Seasonal chloramine conversion', 'Post-LCRR compliance adjustment', 'Filter media replacement', 'Regulatory agency directive'). Required for change management audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: control_mode
attributes.description: The control mode under which this setpoint operates in the SCADA/PLC system. 'automatic' means the control loop maintains the setpoint autonomously; 'manual' means operator-directed; 'cascade' means the output of one controller drives the setpoint of another; 'ratio' and 'feedforward' are advanced control strategies.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1; ISA-88 Batch Control; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this setpoint record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the setpoint lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: deadband_value
attributes.description: The deadband or hysteresis value around the setpoint within which no corrective control action is taken. Prevents excessive actuator cycling (e.g., chemical dosing pump hunting). Expressed in the same engineering unit as setpoint_value.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian Deadband Attribute

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this setpoint value became or becomes operationally effective in the control system. Used for temporal tracking of setpoint changes and regulatory audit trails. Aligns with MOR reporting periods.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR; ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The engineering unit associated with the setpoint value and alarm limits (e.g., mg/L for chlorine residual, NTU for turbidity, pH for potential of hydrogen, GPM for flow rate, PSI for pressure). Critical for correct interpretation of all numeric fields on this record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg/L|NTU|pH|GPM|MGD|PSI|°C|°F|%|hours|minutes|mg/L/min|mV|ft|scfm — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISA-5.1; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian Engineering Units

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this setpoint version expires or is scheduled to be superseded. Null for open-ended setpoints with no planned expiry. Supports scheduled setpoint reviews and seasonal adjustments (e.g., summer/winter chloramine dosing targets).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control; EPA SWTR

attributes.name: high_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The high alarm threshold for the process variable. When the measured value exceeds this limit, a high alarm is triggered in the SCADA/HMI system, alerting operators to take corrective action. Expressed in the same engineering unit as setpoint_value.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian HI Attribute

attributes.name: high_trip_limit
attributes.description: The high-high (HH) trip or shutdown limit for the process variable. Exceeding this value triggers an automatic safety interlock or process shutdown (e.g., chlorine over-feed trip, filter bypass). More severe than the high alarm limit. Expressed in the same engineering unit as setpoint_value.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2; IEC 61511 Functional Safety; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian HH Attribute

attributes.name: is_ct_compliance_parameter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this setpoint is a CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) compliance parameter as required under the EPA Surface Water Treatment Rule. CT compliance parameters (e.g., chlorine residual, contact time) are subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny and must be tracked in MOR submissions.
attributes.references: EPA SWTR (40 CFR Part 141 Subpart H); AWWA M56; State Primacy Agency Rules

attributes.name: is_mcl_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this setpoint is directly associated with an EPA or state MCL parameter (e.g., chlorine residual, turbidity, pH for corrosion control under LCRR). MCL-related setpoints require additional documentation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA MCL Table (40 CFR Part 141); LCRR; State Primacy Agency Rules

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this setpoint record was most recently updated. Tracks the most recent change event for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: low_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The low alarm threshold for the process variable. When the measured value falls below this limit, a low alarm is triggered in the SCADA/HMI system. Expressed in the same engineering unit as setpoint_value.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian LO Attribute

attributes.name: low_trip_limit
attributes.description: The low-low (LL) trip or shutdown limit for the process variable. Falling below this value triggers an automatic safety interlock or process shutdown (e.g., chlorine under-feed trip, pump cavitation protection). More severe than the low alarm limit. Expressed in the same engineering unit as setpoint_value.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2; IEC 61511 Functional Safety; AWWA Process Control; OSIsoft PI Historian LL Attribute

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational context, special conditions, or instructions associated with this setpoint (e.g., 'Applies only during peak demand hours', 'Coordinate with distribution operations before adjustment', 'Seasonal adjustment per SWTR CT table'). Supplements the change_reason field.

attributes.name: operator_certification_grade
attributes.description: The certification grade level of the operator who approved this setpoint (e.g., Grade I through Grade IV per state drinking water operator certification programs). Ensures the approving operator holds the appropriate grade for the facility classification.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Operator Certification; State Primacy Agency Rules

attributes.name: operator_license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued operator certification license number of the operator who approved this setpoint. Stored directly on the setpoint record for regulatory traceability without requiring a join, as required by MOR and DMR submissions.
attributes.references: EPA SDWA Operator Certification Requirements; State Primacy Agency Rules

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the process variable being controlled (e.g., water_quality for chlorine/pH/turbidity, flow_rate for GPM targets, pressure for PSI limits, chemical_dose for mg/L targets, equipment_runtime for filter run time). Drives analytics segmentation and alarm management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: water_quality|flow_rate|pressure|chemical_dose|equipment_runtime|level|temperature — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems; AWWA Process Control

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The treatment process area or stage to which this setpoint belongs. Classifies the setpoint within the treatment train for process control, analytics, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coagulation_flocculation|sedimentation|filtration|disinfection|chemical_dosing|membrane_treatment|residuals_management|distribution_pumping|wastewater_primary|wastewater_secondary|wastewater_tertiary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AWWA Water Treatment Plant Design; EPA SWTR; WEF MOP 8

attributes.name: ramp_rate
attributes.description: The maximum rate at which the setpoint value may be changed per unit time (expressed in engineering_unit per minute). Prevents sudden process upsets during setpoint transitions (e.g., gradual chlorine dose ramp-up after a plant restart). Null if no ramp rate constraint applies.
