attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: monitoring_location
attributes.description: The specific location where monitoring or sampling must occur (e.g., 'Outfall 001', 'Effluent Discharge Point A', 'Influent to Primary Treatment', 'Final Effluent'). May reference a specific outfall, sampling point, or monitoring station.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or operational guidance related to this permit condition. May include cross-references to other permit sections, special instructions for compliance staff, or historical context.

attributes.name: numeric_limit
attributes.description: The numeric threshold value for the effluent limit or monitoring requirement. Null for narrative conditions or qualitative requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the regulated parameter (e.g., '00310' for BOD, '00530' for TSS, '00400' for pH, '00600' for TDS). Uses EPA STORET or equivalent parameter coding system.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) STORET Parameter Code Registry

attributes.name: public_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether violations of this condition require public notification (e.g., inclusion in Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), public notice in local newspaper, notification to downstream water users). True if public notification is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Public Notification Rule

attributes.name: quality_assurance_requirement
attributes.description: Specific quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements for monitoring and sampling (e.g., 'EPA Method 1664A for FOG', 'Standard Methods 5210B for BOD', 'EPA Method 200.8 for metals', 'Chain of custody required', 'Laboratory must be state-certified', 'Duplicate samples required quarterly').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Methods for Chemical Analysis of Water and Wastes

attributes.name: receiving_water_body
attributes.description: The name of the receiving water body (river, stream, lake, estuary, ocean, groundwater) into which the discharge occurs and for which this condition is designed to protect water quality (e.g., 'Mississippi River', 'Lake Michigan', 'Chesapeake Bay', 'Atlantic Ocean', 'Groundwater Aquifer Zone IIA').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: record_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days that monitoring records, laboratory results, and compliance documentation for this condition must be retained by the permittee. Typically 3 years (1095 days) for NPDES permits, but may be longer for certain parameters or enforcement actions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program (40 CFR 122.41)

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The legal or regulatory authority for this condition (e.g., 'Clean Water Act Section 301', 'SDWA Section 1412', '40 CFR 122.44', 'State Water Quality Standard Chapter 62-302', 'Technology-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Water Quality-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Best Available Technology (BAT)', 'Best Conventional Pollutant Control Technology (BCT)').
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Clean Water Act (CWA) and Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA)

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for reporting monitoring results to the regulatory agency via Monthly Operating Report (MOR) or Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR): monthly, quarterly, annually, event-based (for spills or exceedances), or not required (internal monitoring only).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Program

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The type of sample required for compliance monitoring: grab (single instantaneous sample), composite (time-weighted or flow-weighted composite over specified period), continuous (real-time monitoring), or flow-weighted (proportional to flow rate).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: seasonal_period
attributes.description: The time period during which seasonal variations apply (e.g., 'May 1 - September 30', 'Winter: November 1 - March 31', 'Low Flow Season: June - August'). Null if no seasonal variation applies.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: seasonal_variation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition has seasonal variations in limits or monitoring requirements (e.g., more stringent limits during low-flow summer months, reduced monitoring during winter). True if seasonal variations apply, False otherwise.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Permit Writers Manual

attributes.name: technology_requirement
attributes.description: Specific treatment technology or operational practice mandated by this condition (e.g., 'Secondary Treatment', 'Ultraviolet (UV) Disinfection', 'Granular Activated Carbon (GAC) Filtration', 'Reverse Osmosis (RO)', 'Microfiltration (MF)', 'Ultrafiltration (UF)', 'Fats Oils and Grease (FOG) Pretreatment', 'Best Management Practice (BMP) for Stormwater'). Null for non-technology-based conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Effluent Guidelines and Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the numeric limit (e.g., 'mg/L' for milligrams per liter, 'ug/L' for micrograms per liter, 'NTU' for Nephelometric Turbidity Units, 'SU' for Standard Units (pH), 'MPN/100mL' for Most Probable Number per 100 milliliters, 'lbs/day' for pounds per day, 'MGD' for Million Gallons per Day).
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) STORET Unit Code Registry

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this permit condition record was last updated in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: violation_threshold
attributes.description: The numeric value at which a violation is triggered. May differ from the numeric limit if the permit allows for measurement uncertainty, rounding conventions, or compliance margins. Null for narrative conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) NPDES Compliance Inspection Manual

attributes.name: water_quality_standard_basis
attributes.description: The specific water quality standard or criterion that this condition is designed to protect (e.g., 'Aquatic Life Chronic Criterion', 'Human Health - Fish Consumption', 'Drinking Water Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL)', 'Recreational Water Quality Standard', 'Anti-Degradation Policy Tier II'). Null for technology-based conditions.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Water Quality Standards Handbook

attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for US-based water utilities.

attributes.name: delivery_condition
attributes.description: The physical condition of the delivered goods at the time of receipt. Good indicates acceptable condition, damaged indicates physical damage, partial indicates incomplete delivery, incorrect indicates wrong items, contaminated indicates quality issues.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The delivery note or packing slip number provided by the vendor at the time of delivery. Used for cross-referencing with vendor documentation.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by receiving personnel regarding the delivery. May include observations about packaging, condition, discrepancies, or special handling.

attributes.name: gr_document_date
attributes.description: The date on the goods receipt document, typically the date of physical receipt or delivery note date.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known goods receipt document number generated by the ERP system. Used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gr_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the goods receipt was posted in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for inventory valuation and financial accounting.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the goods receipt transaction in its lifecycle. Posted indicates successful receipt, reversed indicates cancellation, pending inspection indicates awaiting QC, completed indicates fully processed.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number created for this goods receipt if quality inspection is required. Links to quality management records.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor invoice was verified and matched against this goods receipt. Null if invoice not yet received or verified.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The system user ID who last modified this goods receipt record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this goods receipt record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt material document was created. Used as part of the document key in SAP MM.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that classifies the type of goods receipt transaction. Common types: 101 (GR for PO), 103 (GR into blocked stock), 105 (GR from release order), 161 (GR for returnable transport packaging), 501 (GR without PO), 511 (GR from delivery without PO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|103|105|161|501|511|Z01|Z02 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material requires quality inspection before it can be released for use. True if inspection is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service received and accepted. Measured in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: receiving_personnel_name
attributes.description: The name of the warehouse or operations personnel who physically received and verified the goods. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when this goods receipt was reversed or cancelled. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was cancelled. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. True if reversed, False if active.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this goods receipt was reversed. Examples include incorrect quantity, wrong material, damaged goods, vendor return.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types such as consignment stock, returnable packaging, or project stock. Blank for standard stock.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The type of stock into which the material was received. Unrestricted stock is available for use, quality inspection stock is pending QC, blocked stock is not available, restricted stock has limited use.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Matched indicates all documents agree, variance indicates discrepancies, blocked indicates payment hold.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The total value of the goods receipt calculated as received quantity multiplied by unit price. Used for financial posting and invoice verification.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the received quantity. Common units include EA (each), GAL (gallons) for chemicals, LB (pounds), KG (kilograms), L (liters), TON (tons), DRUM, CYL (cylinder). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|LB|GAL|KG|L|M|FT|TON|BAG|DRUM|PAIL|CYL|BOX — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of measure for the received material as per the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and three-way match.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific physical location or dock where the goods were unloaded at the facility. Used for logistics tracking and facility management.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The valuation type used for split valuation of materials with different prices or qualities. Used when the same material is valued differently based on source or quality.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number provided by the vendor on the delivery documentation. Used for vendor traceability and quality issues.

products.name: inventory_stock
products.description: Current stock levels for all materials and chemicals held across utility warehouses, treatment plant storage, and field storerooms. Captures material number, storage location, plant, unrestricted stock quantity, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, reserved quantity, reorder point, maximum stock level, safety stock level, days of supply remaining, last physical inventory date, book vs counted quantity (for physical inventory reconciliation), chemical-specific attributes (tank ID, expiry date, hazmat classification), and last replenishment date. Supports chemical dosing continuity, maintenance spare parts availability, and physical inventory audit. Aligns with SAP MM stock overview (MARD/MMBE) and physical inventory (IKPF/ISEG).
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Overview (MARD/MMBE)

attributes.name: inventory_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory stock record. Primary key for the inventory stock data product.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARD table primary key convention

attributes.name: primary_inventory_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant or facility where the storage location resides. Links to WTP, WWTP, or operations center.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record. Links to the material being stocked (chemicals, spare parts, equipment, consumables).

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.territory. Business justification: Territory-level inventory planning and emergency response SLA compliance require knowing which service territory each stock location serves. Utilities track available pipe repair materials and meters

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location where the material is held. Links to warehouse, chemical storage facility, or field storeroom.
attributes.references: SAP MM T001L storage location master

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A = high-value/critical items requiring tight control; B = moderate-value items; C = low-value items with relaxed controls.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-ABCIN ABC analysis; inventory management best practices

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for new consumption or reservation. Calculated as unrestricted stock minus reserved quantity.

attributes.name: average_daily_consumption
attributes.description: Average quantity consumed per day based on historical usage. Used for demand forecasting and reorder point calculation.
attributes.references: SAP MM consumption-based planning; inventory optimization

attributes.name: batch_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is managed at the batch level. True for chemicals and materials requiring lot tracking for quality, expiration, or regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-XCHPF batch management indicator

attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material blocked from use due to quality issues, expiration, damage, or regulatory hold. Cannot be issued until block is removed.

attributes.name: consignment_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock is held on consignment from a vendor. Consignment stock remains vendor-owned until consumed, reducing carrying costs.
attributes.references: SAP MM consignment stock process; vendor-managed inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory stock record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SAP MM audit trail; data governance standards

attributes.name: cycle_count_indicator
attributes.description: Frequency classification for cycle counting. A = high-frequency (monthly); B = medium-frequency (quarterly); C = low-frequency (annual); X = excluded from cycle counting.
attributes.references: SAP MM physical inventory cycle counting; inventory audit best practices

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Number of days the current available stock will last based on average daily consumption. Calculated as available quantity divided by average daily consumption.
attributes.references: Inventory management KPI; supply chain analytics

attributes.name: expiration_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material has a limited shelf life and requires expiration date tracking. True for chemicals, reagents, and time-sensitive consumables.
attributes.references: SAP MM batch management shelf-life expiration date (SLED)

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and regulatory compliance (e.g., chlorine gas, sodium hypochlorite, acids).
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA hazardous materials regulations

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock for this material at this location.
attributes.references: SAP MM MKPF-BUDAT goods issue posting date

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock for this material at this location.
attributes.references: SAP MM MKPF-BUDAT goods receipt posting date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory stock record was last updated. Tracks any change to stock quantities, valuation, or master data attributes.
attributes.references: SAP MM audit trail; data governance standards

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count for this material at this storage location. Used to track inventory accuracy and compliance with audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARD-LMINR/LMENG physical inventory date; GASB inventory audit requirements

attributes.name: last_stock_adjustment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent manual stock adjustment or inventory correction transaction for this material at this location.
attributes.references: SAP MM inventory adjustment posting date

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Planned delivery time in days from purchase requisition creation to goods receipt. Used for reorder point calculation and procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-PLIFZ planned delivery time

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum quantity to be maintained in stock. Used for inventory optimization and to prevent overstocking of chemicals with limited shelf life or high carrying costs.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-MAXBE maximum stock level

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure used for automatic replenishment. PD = MRP; VB = manual reorder point; VM = forecast-based planning; ND = no planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-DISMM MRP type; materials planning procedures

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility (e.g., WTP1, WWTP2, DIST).

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured. External = purchased from vendors; In-house = manufactured or produced internally; Both = can be procured either way.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently under quality inspection. Stock is on hold pending laboratory testing or quality assurance approval before release to unrestricted use.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARD-INSME quality inspection stock

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum stock level that triggers automatic replenishment. When available quantity falls below this threshold, a purchase requisition is generated.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-MINBE reorder point; inventory management best practices

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of unrestricted stock reserved for specific work orders, maintenance activities, or planned consumption. Reserved stock is committed but not yet issued.
attributes.references: SAP MM reservation and commitment logic

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock maintained to protect against stockouts due to demand variability or supply delays. Critical for chemicals required for continuous treatment operations.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-EISBE safety stock; inventory management best practices

attributes.name: serial_number_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is managed at the serial number level. True for high-value equipment and assets requiring individual unit tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARC-SERNR serial number profile

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current status of stock availability. Derived from comparison of available quantity against reorder point and maximum stock level thresholds.

attributes.name: stock_turnover_ratio
attributes.description: Number of times inventory is consumed and replenished during a period. Indicates inventory efficiency and demand velocity.
attributes.references: Inventory management KPI; financial performance metrics

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of stock ownership and purpose. Distinguishes between utility-owned stock, vendor consignment, project-specific stock, and other special stock categories.
attributes.references: SAP MM special stock types; inventory classification

attributes.name: stock_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of unrestricted stock at this location. Calculated as unrestricted quantity multiplied by material standard price or moving average price.
attributes.references: SAP MM MBEW valuation; GASB 34 capital asset reporting

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the storage location (e.g., WTP chemical storage, WWTP chemical storage, central warehouse, field storeroom).
attributes.references: SAP MM storage location code standard

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for stock quantities (e.g., EA for each, LB for pounds, GAL for gallons, KG for kilograms, L for liters).
attributes.references: SAP MM MARA-MEINS base unit of measure; ISO 80000

attributes.name: unrestricted_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for unrestricted use. This stock is available for consumption, transfer, or issue to work orders and operations.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for stock valuation (e.g., USD for United States Dollar).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency codes; SAP MM valuation currency

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement including goods receipts, goods issues to work orders, transfers between storage locations, returns to vendor (movement type 122/161), physical inventory adjustments, and scrap postings. Captures movement type, material, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination storage location, posting date, reference document (work order, PO, reservation), movement reason, return reason code, and vendor reference for returns. Provides full material ledger traceability. Aligns with SAP MM Material Document (MSEG/MKPF).
products.reference: SAP MM Material Document (MSEG/MKPF)

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement record.

attributes.name: backwash_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.backwash_event. Business justification: Backwash events consume filter media and backwash chemicals, generating specific stock movements. Linking stock_movement to backwash_event enables per-event material consumption tracking, filter media

attributes.name: chemical_dose_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.chemical_dose_event. Business justification: Chemical consumption stock movements in water treatment are directly triggered by dosing events. Linking stock_movement to chemical_dose_event enables chemical consumption cost accounting, inventory d

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Ten-character cost center code to which the material movement cost is charged. Used for internal consumption and expense allocation.

attributes.name: from_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse_location. Business justification: Stock movements track transfers between warehouse locations. Currently uses denormalized storage_location_from STRING; should be proper FK. Label prefix 'from_' distinguishes source location from dest

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Stock movements (issues to work orders, projects, or departments) in water utilities require fund coding for GASB governmental accounting compliance. Materials issued from inventory must be charged to

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Ten-digit general ledger account number to which the material movement value is posted. Determines the financial accounting impact.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: Stock movements of type 'goods receipt' should link to the originating goods_receipt record for full traceability. Currently uses denormalized goods_receipt_slip_number STRING; should be proper FK. En

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line_item. Business justification: stock_movement currently references purchase_order_id (existing FK) and stores purchase_order_item (INT) as a denormalized line item number. Adding po_line_item_id as a proper FK to po_line_item norma

attributes.name: primary_stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being moved. Links to the material master record for chemicals, spare parts, or other inventory items.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Stock movements related to procurement should link to the originating purchase order for cost tracking and audit trail. Currently uses denormalized purchase_order_number STRING; should be proper FK. C

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor from whom material was received (for goods receipt movements). Null for internal movements and issues.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: In water utilities capital projects, inventory issues (goods issues) are charged to WBS elements for project cost capitalization and CIP cost tracking. The existing plain-text 'wbs_element' column is

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.work_order. Business justification: Material consumption (goods issues, movement type 261) is posted against work orders in SAP PM. Linking stock_movement to work_order enables accurate material cost tracking per work order — required f

attributes.name: amount_in_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary value of the material movement in the local currency of the plant (typically USD for U.S. water utilities). Calculated as quantity × unit price.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number if this material movement is capitalized as part of an asset acquisition or improvement. Links to asset management for depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the batch or lot of material being moved. Critical for chemicals (chlorine, coagulants, polymers) to track expiration, quality, and traceability.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: External document number from the vendor's delivery note or packing slip. Used for goods receipt reconciliation and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the external document (e.g., delivery note, packing slip, invoice) that accompanies the material movement. May differ from posting date.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material document was created in the system. Audit timestamp for record creation.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material document was created in the system. Provides precise audit trail for transaction timing.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this material movement transaction in the ERP system. Serves as the business identifier for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Part of the compound key in SAP MM along with material document number.

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character indicator for special movement scenarios: B=Goods Movement for Purchase Order, H=Reversal Movement, F=Goods Movement for Production Order, E=Goods Movement for Sales Order, L=Goods Movement for Delivery.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material movement transaction: posted=Successfully posted to inventory and accounting, pending=Awaiting approval or verification, cancelled=Reversed or voided, error=Failed posting requiring correction.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Three-digit code classifying the type of inventory movement (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Work Order, 311=Transfer Posting, 122=Return to Vendor, 701=Physical Inventory Adjustment). Determines the accounting and inventory impact.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the physical inventory count document if this movement is an inventory adjustment resulting from a cycle count or annual physical inventory.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility where the material movement occurred (e.g., WTP1=Water Treatment Plant 1, WWTP=Wastewater Treatment Plant).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material movement was posted to inventory and financial accounting. Represents the business event date for the transaction.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Ten-character profit center code for internal management accounting and segment reporting. Used to allocate costs and revenues to business units or service areas.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved in this transaction, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code explaining the reason for the material movement (e.g., MAINT=Maintenance Consumption, EMER=Emergency Issue, QUAL=Quality Hold, SCRAP=Scrap/Disposal, RETN=Return to Vendor). Provides additional context beyond movement type.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this material movement is a reversal (cancellation) of a previous movement. True if this is a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number of the original transaction that this movement reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code for special stock types: E=Sales Order Stock, K=Consignment Stock, O=Project Stock, Q=Quality Inspection Stock, W=Returnable Packaging. Blank for standard unrestricted stock.

attributes.name: storage_location_to
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the destination storage location to which material was moved. Null for goods issues to external consumption.

attributes.name: text_header
attributes.description: Free-form text field at the document header level providing additional context, notes, or instructions for the entire material movement transaction.

attributes.name: text_item
attributes.description: Free-form text field at the line item level providing specific notes or details about this particular material movement (e.g., condition observed, special handling instructions).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, GAL=Gallon, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter). Aligns with ISO unit codes.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Physical location or dock where material was received or issued. Provides granular location tracking within a plant or warehouse.

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: System user ID of the person who created or posted the material movement transaction. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Code used to differentiate materials with the same material number but different valuations (e.g., different procurement sources, quality grades). Enables split valuation for inventory accounting.

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master data for all physical storage locations within the utility's warehouse and field storeroom network. Captures location code, description, facility type (central warehouse, WTP chemical store, WWTP chemical store, field storeroom), address, storage conditions (temperature-controlled, hazmat-rated, outdoor), capacity, responsible custodian, and SAP MM plant/storage location assignment. Enables inventory segregation and chemical safety compliance.
products.reference: SAP MM Storage Location (LGORT/T001L)

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse location record. Primary key.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.territory. Business justification: Territory-to-warehouse assignment drives field crew dispatch and inventory replenishment planning. Water utilities assign warehouses to service territories so dispatchers know which storeroom field cr

attributes.name: access_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours or access schedule for the warehouse location. May be 24/7, business hours only, or by appointment.
attributes.references: AWWA M5 - Water Utility Management Practices

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the warehouse location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building, suite, or unit number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: available_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Currently available storage capacity in square feet. Updated based on inventory levels and space allocation.
attributes.references: AWWA M5 - Water Utility Management Practices

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for capacity reporting. Supports square feet, square meters, cubic feet, cubic meters, or pallet positions.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the warehouse location is situated. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the warehouse location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse location record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: custodian_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the warehouse custodian. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: custodian_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the warehouse custodian. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse location was decommissioned or ceased operations. Null for active locations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse location became operational and available for inventory storage.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse facility based on its operational purpose. Central warehouse serves enterprise-wide inventory; WTP (Water Treatment Plant) and WWTP (Wastewater Treatment Plant) chemical stores hold treatment chemicals; field storerooms support distribution network maintenance; maintenance depots support asset management; emergency stockpiles hold critical spare parts.
attributes.references: AWWA M5 - Water Utility Management Practices

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed at the warehouse location. Critical for chemical storage safety and insurance compliance.
attributes.references: NFPA 13 - Installation of Sprinkler Systems; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.159

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is certified for storage of hazardous materials such as chlorine, coagulants, polymers, and other treatment chemicals. Required for chemical procurement and FOG (Fats Oils and Grease) management compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120 - HAZWOPER; EPA RCRA Subtitle C

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the warehouse location and its contents. Business-sensitive financial data.

attributes.name: inventory_cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency for physical inventory cycle counts at this location. Supports inventory accuracy and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Financial Reporting; SAP MM Best Practices

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or compliance inspection of the warehouse location.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse location record was last updated.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the warehouse location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration and logistics optimization.
attributes.references: WGS 84 - World Geodetic System; Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the warehouse location. Unique alphanumeric code used in SAP MM and operational systems for inventory transactions and storage location assignment.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the warehouse location, including purpose, layout, and special characteristics.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the warehouse or storeroom location.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the warehouse location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration and logistics optimization.
attributes.references: WGS 84 - World Geodetic System; Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next safety or compliance inspection of the warehouse location.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or operational notes about the warehouse location.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the warehouse location. Indicates whether the location is available for inventory storage and transactions.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the warehouse location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: responsible_custodian
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role responsible for managing and securing the warehouse location. Accountable for inventory accuracy and safety compliance.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP MM plant code to which this warehouse location is assigned. Links warehouse location to the SAP organizational structure for materials management and procurement.

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP MM storage location code within the plant. Used for inventory transactions, goods receipts, and goods issues in SAP ERP.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Physical security classification of the warehouse location. Determines access control requirements and monitoring protocols.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 - Information Security Management; OSHA Security Standards

attributes.name: spill_containment_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location has spill containment infrastructure for chemical storage. Required for EPA SPCC (Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasure) compliance.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the warehouse is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 - Country Subdivision Codes; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Environmental and safety classification of the storage location. Indicates whether the location is temperature-controlled, hazmat-rated for chemical storage, or outdoor. Critical for chemical procurement compliance and inventory safety. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|temperature_controlled|refrigerated|hazmat_rated|outdoor_covered|outdoor_uncovered|climate_controlled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 - Flammable and Combustible Liquids; EPA 40 CFR 112 - SPCC

attributes.name: temperature_control_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location has active temperature control systems (HVAC). Required for certain chemical and equipment storage.

products.name: approved_source
products.description: This association product represents the Approved Vendor List (AVL) contract between a vendor and a material in the water utility's supply chain. It captures each formally approved vendor-material sourcing relationship, including vendor-specific pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, approval status, and preferred vendor ranking. Each record links one vendor to one material master entry and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific sourcing relationship. Aligns with SAP MM Source List (ME01) and supports multi-source procurement policy for critical water treatment chemicals and spare parts.. Existence Justification: In water utilities procurement, a single material (e.g., liquid chlorine, alum, polymer) must be sourced from multiple approved vendors for supply security and regulatory compliance, and each vendor supplies many different materials. The Approved Vendor List (AVL) / Source List is a well-established SAP MM operational concept (transaction ME01) that water utilities actively manage — procurement staff create, update, and expire individual vendor-material approval records with their own pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and approval status. This is not an analytical correlation; it is an operational business entity that procurement teams manage daily.

products.name: contract_line_item
products.description: This association product represents the Contract (line-item commitment) between procurement_contract and material_master. It captures the material-level terms within a procurement outline agreement — including negotiated unit price, target quantity, release tracking, and line-level validity — that exist only in the context of a specific contract-material combination. Each record links one procurement_contract to one material_master and corresponds to a SAP MM outline agreement item (EKPO). Supports chemical supply planning, OPEX budget tracking, and vendor performance monitoring at the material level.. Existence Justification: In water utilities procurement, a single procurement contract (outline agreement) routinely covers multiple materials — e.g., a chemical supply contract may cover chlorine, alum, polymer, and caustic soda each with individual pricing schedules and quantity commitments. Conversely, a single material (e.g., chlorine) can be covered by multiple active contracts with different vendors or contract periods. This is the well-established SAP MM concept of 'outline agreement items' (EKPO), where each contract line item represents a distinct material-level commitment with its own target quantity, unit price, and validity terms that belong neither to the contract header nor to the material master alone.
