attributes.name: is_budget_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to budget controls and variance monitoring (True). Typically applies to operating expense accounts and capital project accounts where budget compliance is mandatory.

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used to track capital expenditures (CAPEX) that will be capitalized and depreciated (True) versus operating expenditures (OPEX) that are expensed immediately (False).

attributes.name: is_grant_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this account are eligible for grant reimbursement or cost allocation to grant-funded projects (True). Used for grant management and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Grant Compliance

attributes.name: is_operating_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used to track operating expenditures (OPEX) that are expensed in the current period (True) versus capital expenditures (CAPEX) that are capitalized (False).

attributes.name: is_posting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct transaction postings are allowed to this account (True) or if it is a summary-only account (False). Summary accounts typically block direct postings to ensure data integrity.

attributes.name: is_rate_case_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs in this account are eligible for inclusion in rate case filings and cost-of-service calculations for regulatory rate-setting (True). Critical for Public Utilities Commission (PUC) rate proceedings.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission (PUC) - Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external records or sub-ledgers (True). Typically applies to balance sheet accounts such as cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and fixed assets.

attributes.name: is_summary_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a summary/parent account (True) that aggregates child accounts or a detail/leaf account (False) that receives direct transaction postings. Summary accounts typically do not allow direct postings.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this general ledger account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date when this general ledger account record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: The normal balance side for this account type: debit for assets and expenses, credit for liabilities, equity, and revenues. Determines how increases and decreases are recorded.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or clarifications about the use and purpose of this general ledger account. Used for internal documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center identifier for internal management reporting and profitability analysis. Used to segment financial performance by business line (e.g., 'WATER-RES' for residential water, 'WATER-IND' for industrial water, 'WASTEWATER' for wastewater services).

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP ERP company code that owns this general ledger account. Company code is the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting purposes.

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical account (True) used to track non-monetary metrics (e.g., gallons treated, customer count, work orders completed) versus a financial account (False) that tracks monetary values.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code or tax category applicable to transactions posted to this account. Used for sales tax, use tax, and other tax compliance reporting. May be null for non-taxable accounts.

attributes.name: tyler_munis_account_code
attributes.description: The corresponding account identifier in Tyler Technologies Munis system for municipalities that use Munis for financial and utility billing. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.
attributes.references: Tyler Technologies Munis - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for statistical accounts (e.g., 'MGD' for Million Gallons per Day, 'EA' for Each, 'KWH' for Kilowatt Hours). Null for financial accounts that track monetary values only.
attributes.references: American Water Works Association (AWWA) - Standard Units

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this general ledger account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: GASB 34 - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

products.name: fund
products.description: Municipal fund master defining the distinct fiscal and accounting funds used by the water utility (e.g., Water Enterprise Fund, Wastewater Enterprise Fund, Capital Projects Fund, Debt Service Fund, Grant Fund). Captures fund type, GASB fund classification, fiscal year, appropriation authority, and fund balance policies per governmental accounting standards.
products.reference: GASB Fund Accounting / Tyler Munis Fund Master

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the municipal fund. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: appropriation_authority
attributes.description: The legal or governing body that authorized the creation and appropriation of this fund (e.g., City Council, Board of Directors, State Legislature). Identifies the source of budgetary authority.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 2200 - Budgetary Accounting and Reporting

attributes.name: appropriation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appropriation authority formally approved the fund and its budget.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 2200 - Budgetary Accounting and Reporting

attributes.name: balance_policy
attributes.description: Description of the utility's policy governing the minimum and maximum fund balance levels, reserve requirements, and conditions under which fund balance may be used. Critical for financial planning and rate case preparation.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 54 - Fund Balance Reporting and Governmental Fund Type Definitions

attributes.name: capital_project_name
attributes.description: Name of the capital project if this fund is a capital projects fund established for a specific construction or infrastructure initiative (e.g., Water Treatment Plant Expansion, Distribution System Upgrade). Null if not a capital projects fund.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1300 - Capital Projects Funds

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fund was officially closed and ceased operations. Null if the fund is still active.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the fund was closed (e.g., project completion, bond fully repaid, grant period ended, fund consolidation). Null if the fund is still active.

attributes.name: component_unit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund belongs to a component unit (a legally separate organization for which the primary government is financially accountable). True if component unit; False if primary government.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 14 - The Financial Reporting Entity

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance and Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: debt_service_bond_issue
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the bond issue if this fund is a debt service fund established to repay specific bonds (e.g., 2020 Water Revenue Bonds). Null if not a debt service fund.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department or division responsible for managing this fund (e.g., WATER, WWTR for wastewater, FIN for finance). Used for organizational reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fund was officially established and began operations.

attributes.name: external_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund is subject to external audit requirements (e.g., Single Audit Act for federal grants, bond covenant audits). True if required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Single Audit Act; GASB Statement 34 - Audit Requirements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this fund record applies, expressed as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Water utilities typically follow calendar year or July-June fiscal cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the fiscal year for this fund (e.g., 2024-12-31 for calendar year or 2025-06-30 for July start).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the fiscal year for this fund (e.g., 2024-01-01 for calendar year or 2024-07-01 for July start).

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the fund in financial transactions and reporting. Typically 2-10 characters following the utility's chart of accounts structure.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fund (e.g., Water Enterprise Fund, Wastewater Enterprise Fund, Capital Projects Fund, Debt Service Fund).

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund. Active funds are in use; inactive funds are dormant but may be reactivated; closed funds are permanently closed; suspended funds are temporarily halted pending review or restructuring.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund based on its purpose and accounting treatment. Enterprise funds are used for business-type activities; capital projects for major construction; debt service for bond repayment; special revenue for restricted purposes; general for unrestricted operations; internal service for inter-departmental services.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Fund Categories and Financial Reporting

attributes.name: gasb_fund_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Fund Classification
attributes.description: High-level GASB classification of the fund. Governmental funds use modified accrual accounting; proprietary funds use full accrual accounting; fiduciary funds hold assets in trust.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_prefix
attributes.description: The prefix or segment of the chart of accounts that identifies all general ledger accounts belonging to this fund. Used to structure the GL hierarchy and ensure proper fund accounting segregation.

attributes.name: grant_award_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the grantor agency for tracking and reporting purposes. Null if not grant-funded.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section G60 - Grants and Entitlements

attributes.name: grant_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the grant program if this fund is associated with a specific federal, state, or local grant (e.g., EPA Clean Water State Revolving Fund, USDA Rural Development Grant). Null if not grant-funded.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section G60 - Grants and Entitlements

attributes.name: interfund_transfer_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfers between this fund and other funds are permitted under the utility's financial policies and legal restrictions. True if allowed; False if restricted.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was last updated in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance and Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the fund manager for official correspondence and reporting inquiries.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for managing and overseeing this fund (e.g., Finance Director, Capital Projects Manager). Used for accountability and contact purposes.

attributes.name: minimum_fund_balance_amount
attributes.description: The minimum fund balance amount (in USD) that must be maintained per the fund balance policy. Used to ensure liquidity and financial stability.

attributes.name: minimum_fund_balance_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum fund balance expressed as a percentage of annual operating expenditures or revenues, per the fund balance policy (e.g., 15.00 for 15%).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the fund (e.g., unique accounting treatments, historical context, pending policy changes).

attributes.name: rate_case_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fund's financial data is included in rate case filings and cost-of-service studies submitted to the Public Utilities Commission. True if included; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_entity
attributes.description: Name of the legal or organizational entity that reports this fund in its financial statements (e.g., City of Springfield Water Department, Regional Water Authority). Used for consolidation and component unit reporting.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 14 - The Financial Reporting Entity

attributes.name: restricted_purpose
attributes.description: Description of any legal or contractual restrictions on the use of fund resources (e.g., bond covenants, grant conditions, regulatory mandates). Null if the fund is unrestricted.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master aligned to SAP CO cost center accounting. Represents operational units (WTP operations, WWTP operations, distribution maintenance, metering, customer service, administration) for OPEX tracking, internal cost allocation, and departmental budget control. Includes cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, functional area, and profit center assignment.
products.reference: SAP CO Cost Center / AWWA Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent cost center in the cost center hierarchy, enabling roll-up reporting and organizational structure representation.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Primary activity type for activity-based costing. Examples: Labor Hours, Machine Hours, MGD Treated, Miles Maintained. Used for internal service charge-out.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved operating expenditure (OPEX) budget for the current fiscal year. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and departmental cost control.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Primary asset class associated with this cost center for capital vs. operating expense allocation. Examples: Treatment Plant, Distribution System, Metering Infrastructure.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for budget amounts. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: budget_profile
attributes.description: Budget control profile defining budget availability check rules, tolerance limits, and budget period (annual, quarterly, monthly).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area for segment reporting and cross-company code consolidation. Examples: Water Operations, Wastewater Operations, Shared Services.

attributes.name: capex_opex_split_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) / Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Split Percentage
attributes.description: Default percentage split for capital vs. operating expense allocation when costs are posted to this center. Used for CIP vs. O&M budget tracking.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Capital vs. Operating Classification

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP Company Code representing the legal entity for financial accounting. Used for GAAP/GASB financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area to which this cost center belongs. Typically represents the legal entity or consolidated reporting unit.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used for internal cost allocation and overhead distribution. Direct for production centers; assessment or activity-based for shared services.

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization for cost center grouping and reporting. Operations includes WTP, WWTP, distribution; capital includes CIP projects; shared services includes IT, HR, finance.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cost center, typically alphanumeric code used in SAP FI/CO and financial reporting. Examples: WTP-OPS, WWTP-01, DIST-MAINT.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and operational responsibilities.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center. Examples: Water Treatment Plant Operations, Wastewater Treatment Plant Maintenance, Distribution Network Maintenance, Customer Service Department.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active centers accept postings; inactive centers are closed; blocked centers are temporarily suspended; planned centers are future organizational units.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional type. Production centers directly deliver water/wastewater services; service centers support operations; administrative centers handle management functions.

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: Default cost element group for expense categorization. Examples: Personnel Costs, Materials, Utilities, Contracted Services, Depreciation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this cost center record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department identifier for organizational reporting and workforce management integration. Links to HR organizational structure.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area assignment for cross-organizational cost reporting. Examples: Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment, Distribution, Metering, Customer Service, Administration, Laboratory, Asset Management.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service area for regional cost analysis and rate case preparation. Examples: North District, South District, Central Region.

attributes.name: grant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses posted to this cost center are eligible for federal or state grant reimbursement (e.g., EPA WIFIA, state revolving fund).
attributes.references: EPA Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (WIFIA)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the cost center hierarchy tree. Level 1 is top-level (e.g., Utility Operations), increasing levels represent more granular organizational units.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this cost center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was last updated.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or facility code where this cost center operates. Examples: WTP-MAIN, WWTP-NORTH, ADMIN-HQ. Links to asset location master.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for additional context, special instructions, or historical information about the cost center.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: overhead_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Overhead allocation rate applied to this cost center for indirect cost distribution. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%).

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center assignment for profitability analysis. Links cost center expenses to revenue-generating business segments (e.g., Residential Water, Commercial Wastewater).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center's expenses must be reported to regulatory agencies (EPA, state PUC) for rate case justification and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cost center is valid and can accept cost postings. Supports time-dependent cost center master data.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this cost center is valid. Null for open-ended validity. Used for cost center closure and reorganization tracking.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry document capturing all financial postings in the water utility's books, including both header metadata and individual debit/credit line items. Header captures journal type (standard, adjusting, closing, reversing), posting date, accounting period, fiscal year, originating module, document number, posting user, approval status, and narrative. Each line item records GL account, fund, cost center, WBS element, functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction and functional currency, tax code, and line text. Supports full double-entry bookkeeping, GASB fund-level reporting, and integration with SAP FI and Tyler Munis posting documents.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry / GASB General Journal

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry header record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Journal entries for revenue recognition, bad debt write-offs, and deferred revenue adjustments reference specific billing accounts for audit trail and AR reconciliation. Utility accountants require th

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: The capital project or work breakdown structure (WBS) element identifier if this journal entry is associated with a specific capital improvement program (CIP) project. Used for project cost tracking and capitalization.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The primary cost center or responsibility center to which this journal entry is assigned for management reporting. Cost centers may represent operational divisions such as water treatment plant (WTP), wastewater treatment plant (WWTP), distribution operations, customer service, or administrative functions.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to funds. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: The grant or award identifier if this journal entry is associated with a specific grant-funded project or program (e.g., EPA State Revolving Fund, USDA Rural Development grant). Used for grant accounting and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 33 - Accounting and Financial Reporting for Nonexchange Transactions

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-13 for utilities using a 13-period calendar) to which this journal entry is posted. Used for period-level financial reporting and closing processes.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who approved this journal entry for posting. Populated only after the entry has been approved. Used for segregation of duties and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was approved for posting. Populated only after approval. Used for audit trail and to track approval timing.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: The number of supporting documents or attachments linked to this journal entry (e.g., scanned invoices, approval memos, spreadsheets). Used to indicate availability of supporting documentation for audit purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or session identifier for grouped journal entries that were posted together as part of a single processing run (e.g., month-end closing batch, payroll posting batch, billing cycle batch). Used for batch-level reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Optional cross-company code organizational segment used for internal management reporting. May represent water treatment, wastewater treatment, distribution, or other operational divisions within the utility.
attributes.references: SAP FI Organizational Structure - Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The organizational unit or legal entity code to which this journal entry belongs. In SAP ERP, the company code represents an independent accounting entity. Water utilities may have multiple company codes for different service territories or subsidiaries.
attributes.references: SAP FI Organizational Structure - Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who created or entered this journal entry in the financial system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the financial system. Used for audit trail and to track entry timing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction currency of this journal entry (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Most water utilities operate in a single currency, but multi-national utilities may post in multiple currencies.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date the source document or transaction occurred, which may differ from the posting date. Used for audit trail and to track when the underlying business event took place.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Principle - Financial Accounting (FI) Configuration Guide

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number assigned to this journal entry by the source system (SAP FI document number or Tyler Munis posting document number). Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Principle - Financial Accounting (FI) Configuration Guide

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency amounts to local currency, if applicable. Populated only for journal entries involving foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this journal entry is posted. Water utilities may operate on a calendar year or a fiscal year ending June 30 or other date depending on municipal requirements.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional classification of this journal entry for governmental financial reporting (e.g., water supply, wastewater treatment, administration, debt service). Used to prepare functional expense statements per GASB requirements.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany or inter-fund transactions between different legal entities or funds within the water utility organization. True if intercompany, false otherwise.

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Narrative description or memo text explaining the business purpose and nature of this journal entry. Provides context for auditors, accountants, and financial analysts reviewing the posting.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Management Discussion and Analysis

attributes.name: journal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by its accounting purpose: standard (regular operational postings), adjusting (period-end accruals and deferrals), closing (fiscal year-end closing entries), reversing (automatic reversal of prior accruals), recurring (template-based repetitive entries), or statistical (non-financial postings for cost allocation).
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: The number of individual line items (debits and credits) contained in this journal entry header. Used for validation and summary reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Principle - Financial Accounting (FI) Configuration Guide

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this journal entry record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: originating_module
attributes.description: The source system module or sub-ledger that generated this journal entry. GL (General Ledger) for manual entries, AP (Accounts Payable) for vendor invoice postings, AR (Accounts Receivable) for customer billing, FA (Fixed Assets) for depreciation, PM (Plant Maintenance) for work order capitalization, MM (Materials Management) for inventory transactions, HR/payroll for labor cost allocation, billing for revenue recognition, asset_accounting for capital asset transactions, or manual for ad-hoc adjustments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GL|AP|AR|FA|PM|MM|HR|payroll|billing|asset_accounting|manual — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP ERP Integration - Sub-Ledger to General Ledger Reconciliation

attributes.name: posted_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who posted this journal entry to the general ledger. Populated only after the entry has been posted. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Populated only after posting. Used for audit trail and to track posting timing.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period and year for financial reporting. Must fall within an open accounting period.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the approval and posting workflow. Draft entries are being prepared, pending approval entries await authorization, approved entries are ready for posting, posted entries have been committed to the general ledger, reversed entries have been backed out, and rejected entries were denied approval.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Management Discussion and Analysis

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center or business segment to which this journal entry is assigned for internal profitability analysis. Profit centers may represent water services, wastewater services, industrial customer segment, or geographic service territories.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier from the source transaction or document (e.g., invoice number, work order number, payroll batch ID, grant award number). Provides traceability back to the originating business event.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Notes to Financial Statements

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The posting date on which this journal entry will be automatically reversed, if applicable. Used for accrual entries that should reverse in the subsequent accounting period.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a prior entry. True if this entry reverses a previous posting (e.g., reversing an accrual in the subsequent period), false otherwise.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Used to maintain audit trail of reversing entries.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Principle - Financial Accounting (FI) Configuration Guide

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system that originated this journal entry. SAP_FI for SAP Financial Accounting, SAP_CO for SAP Controlling, Tyler_Munis for Tyler Technologies municipal financial system, Oracle_CCB for Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing, Maximo for IBM Maximo asset management, or manual_entry for direct GL entries.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or tax type code if this journal entry involves tax calculations (e.g., sales tax on materials purchases, use tax, property tax accruals). Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit line item amounts in this journal entry. Must equal total_debit_amount to maintain double-entry accounting balance.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit line item amounts in this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount to maintain double-entry accounting balance.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1600 - Basis of Accounting

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit and credit line items within a general ledger journal entry. Captures GL account, fund, cost center, WBS element (for CIP projects), functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction currency and functional currency, tax code, and line item text. Supports full double-entry bookkeeping and GASB fund-level reporting.
products.reference: SAP FI Line Item / GASB Journal Line

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the fixed asset associated with this line item. Used for asset acquisitions, disposals, depreciation, and capital project closeouts.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Journal entry lines are posted to funds. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id.

attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible per the utility's bad debt policy. Reduces outstanding balance and impacts allowance for doubtful accounts.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system process that created this AR transaction record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: finance_budget
products.description: Annual operating and capital budget for the water utility, covering both header-level budget metadata and detailed line item allocations by GL account, cost center, fund, and period. Header captures budget version (original, amended, final), fiscal year, budget type (operating, capital, grant), appropriation amount, allotment schedule, budget authority source, and budget officer. Line items capture original amount, current amended budget, encumbrances, actual expenditures to date, available balance, and variance by period. Supports rate case preparation, GASB budget-to-actual reporting, and board-level variance analysis.
products.reference: GASB Budget Appropriation / SAP CO Budget / Tyler Munis Budget

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this budget to a specific capital improvement project, used for CAPEX tracking and project cost management.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgets are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Budgets are established by fund. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Budgets are defined for GL accounts. The gl_account_code STRING should be replaced with FK to general_ledger.general_ledger_id.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant. Business justification: Budgets can be grant-funded, and finance_budget has grant_number as a denormalized string. Adding grant_id normalizes this reference to the grant master, enabling grant-funded budget tracking and repo

attributes.name: allotment_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the appropriation amount allocated for a specific period (e.g., quarterly or monthly allotment), used for cash flow management and spending control.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the count of amendments made to the original budget, used for version control and audit trail.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for budget amendments, documenting the business rationale for changes to the original appropriation.

attributes.name: appropriation_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount appropriated for this budget line, representing the authorized spending limit for the fiscal year.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget was officially approved by the board, commission, or governing authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or body that approved the budget (e.g., Board of Directors, City Council, Finance Committee).

attributes.name: authority_source
attributes.description: Legal or administrative source of budget authority, such as board resolution number, city ordinance, or state appropriation act, providing traceability to the authorizing document.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the budget expenditure type: personnel (salaries and benefits), materials (supplies and inventory), services (contracted services), utilities (energy and water), debt service (principal and interest), or transfers (inter-fund transfers).

attributes.name: budget_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the budget line, explaining the purpose, scope, and intended use of the appropriated funds.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the budget, typically formatted as BUD-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget: draft (in preparation), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (board-approved), active (in effect), or closed (fiscal year ended).

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget: operating (OPEX - day-to-day operations and maintenance), capital (CAPEX - infrastructure and asset investments), or grant (externally funded projects).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amounts (e.g., USD for United States Dollar).

attributes.name: debt_service_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this budget line is designated for debt service payments (principal and interest on bonds or loans).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget expires and spending authority ends, typically the last day of the fiscal year.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget becomes effective and spending authority begins, typically the first day of the fiscal year.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the budget that has been encumbered (committed via purchase orders or contracts) but not yet expended, used for budget availability tracking.

attributes.name: expended_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount expended against this budget line to date, used for budget-to-actual variance analysis and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget applies, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this budget record, used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or annotations related to this budget line, used for internal documentation and clarification.

attributes.name: officer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the budget officer responsible for this budget line, used for communication and escalation.

attributes.name: officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the budget officer or financial manager responsible for this budget line, used for accountability and contact purposes.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Program or project code associated with this budget, enabling program-based budgeting and performance measurement.

attributes.name: rate_case_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this budget line is included in rate case preparation and regulatory filings for rate adjustments.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the budget indicating its lifecycle stage: original (initial submission), amended (board-approved changes), revised (mid-year adjustments), or final (year-end approved).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this budget record, used for accountability and audit purposes.

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Detailed budget line item records within an approved budget, providing granular OPEX and CAPEX allocations by GL account, cost center, fund, and period. Captures original budget amount, current amended budget, encumbrances, actual expenditures to date, available balance, and variance. Enables period-level budget monitoring and variance analysis for utility management and board reporting.
products.reference: SAP CO Budget Line / Tyler Munis Budget Detail

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget line item record. Primary key for the budget line entity.

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Capital budget lines are structured by asset class (water mains, pumps, treatment equipment) for CIP planning and asset renewal prioritization. Supports long-term capital planning and rate case justif

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget lines are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent approved budget document to which this line item belongs. Links to the budget header entity.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Budget lines are allocated to funds. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Budget lines are defined for GL accounts. The gl_account_code STRING should be replaced with FK to general_ledger.general_ledger_id.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.grant. Business justification: Budget line items can be grant-funded, and budget_line has grant_code as a denormalized string. Adding grant_id normalizes this to the grant master, enabling granular grant-funded budget line tracking

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital budget lines in water utilities are allocated at WBS element level for granular CIP project cost control. Linking budget lines to WBS elements enables WBS-level budget vs actual variance repor

attributes.name: actual_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative actual expenditures posted to this budget line item to date within the fiscal year. Represents funds that have been spent and recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: amended_budget_amount
attributes.description: The current amended budget amount for this line item, reflecting all approved budget amendments, transfers, and adjustments since the original budget. This is the current authorized spending limit.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget line item was formally approved by the governing board or authorized budget authority. Typically aligns with the annual budget adoption date.

attributes.name: available_balance_amount
attributes.description: The remaining available budget balance for this line item, calculated as amended budget amount minus encumbrances minus actual expenditures. Represents funds still available for commitment or expenditure.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Classification of the budget line item as either Operating Expenditure (OPEX) or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX). OPEX covers day-to-day operations and maintenance (O&M); CAPEX covers capital improvements and asset acquisitions.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line item. Draft indicates preliminary allocation; approved indicates board-approved allocation; amended indicates modified after approval; frozen indicates no further changes allowed; closed indicates fiscal year end closure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget line item record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: debt_service_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this budget line item represents debt service payments (principal and interest on bonds or loans). True indicates debt service allocation.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of commitments and obligations (purchase orders, contracts, reservations) that have been encumbered against this budget line item but not yet expended. Represents funds reserved for future payment.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for this budget line item. Values typically range from 1 to 12.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget line item is allocated. Typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary source of funding for this budget line item. Indicates whether the expenditure is funded by operating revenue, rate revenue, grants, bond proceeds, loans, reserves, developer contributions, or other sources. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_revenue|rate_revenue|grants|bonds|loans|reserves|developer_contributions|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent budget amendment or adjustment that affected this budget line item. Null if no amendments have been made since original approval.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget line item record was last modified or updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the budget line item, explaining the purpose, scope, and nature of the budgeted expenditure or revenue.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent budget document. Used for ordering and referencing budget line items within the budget.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or explanations related to this budget line item. Used to capture context, justifications, or special instructions.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The original approved budget amount for this line item at the start of the fiscal year. Represents the initial allocation before any amendments or adjustments.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: The Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project code or internal order number to which this budget line item is allocated. Applicable for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) budget lines.

attributes.name: rate_case_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this budget line item is included in the current rate case filing or rate study for regulatory approval. True indicates inclusion in rate case calculations.
attributes.references: Public Utilities Commission Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this budget line item is allocated for regulatory compliance activities (e.g., Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), Clean Water Act (CWA), National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permit compliance). True indicates compliance-related expenditure.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful life in years for capital assets associated with this budget line item. Used for depreciation calculations and asset management planning. Applicable for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) lines only.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between the amended budget amount and actual expenditures for this line item. Positive variance indicates under-spending; negative variance indicates over-spending. Used for budget performance analysis.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the amended budget amount. Calculated as (variance amount / amended budget amount) * 100. Used for Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Standards

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset register for the water utility's capitalized infrastructure and equipment including WTP/WWTP facilities, distribution mains, pumping stations, treatment equipment, vehicles, and IT assets. Captures asset class, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method (straight-line, MACRS), accumulated depreciation, net book value, asset location, responsible cost center, and GASB capital asset classification. Integrates with SAP FI-AA and IBM Maximo asset records.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Master / GASB Capital Assets

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset register.

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset class that categorizes this fixed asset (e.g., WTP Facilities, Distribution Mains, Pumping Stations, Treatment Equipment, Vehicles, IT Assets).

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project under which this asset was constructed or acquired.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational cost center responsible for this asset, used for departmental cost allocation and budget tracking.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: FK to treatment.facility

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Fixed assets are capitalized to specific funds for GASB 34 reporting and fund financial statements. Required for governmental fund accounting.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Fixed assets post to specific GL accounts for asset class tracking, depreciation calculation, and financial statement presentation. Required for GAAP/GASB compliance.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant program that funded this asset acquisition, if applicable. Used for grant compliance tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location where the asset is installed or stored, linking to GIS coordinates and facility records.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Water utility capital assets (pumps, treatment equipment, pipelines) are frequently procured under long-term supply contracts. Linking fixed_asset to procurement_contract enables contract performance

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Capital assets in water utilities are capitalized from POs; linking fixed_asset to purchase_order enables asset capitalization workflows, capital project closeout, and GASB 34 infrastructure reporting

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Fixed assets in water utilities are capitalized from CIP projects via WBS element settlement (SAP asset accounting). The WBS element is the direct source of asset capitalization. fixed_asset already h

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total historical cost of acquiring the asset including purchase price, installation, freight, and other capitalized costs. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was acquired, purchased, or placed into service by the utility.

attributes.name: asset_capacity
attributes.description: Rated capacity or throughput of the asset in appropriate units (e.g., MGD for treatment plants, GPM for pumps, PSI for pressure vessels). The unit of measure is specified in capacity_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fixed asset including specifications, capacity, and distinguishing characteristics.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the fixed asset (e.g., Main Street Pump Station, Water Treatment Plant Building A).

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset indicating its operational state and availability.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier assigned to the physical asset for tracking and inventory purposes. Typically affixed to the asset as a barcode or RFID tag.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the asset capacity (e.g., MGD - Million Gallons per Day, GPM - Gallons per Minute, PSI - Pounds per Square Inch, HP - Horsepower).

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment of the asset based on inspections and condition assessments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of the asset based on its impact on service delivery, public health, regulatory compliance, and operational continuity.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate depreciation expense for this asset. Straight-line is most common for municipal utilities; MACRS (Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System) may be used for tax purposes.
attributes.references: GASB Statement 34 - Depreciation Methods; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was physically disposed of, sold, scrapped, or transferred out of the utility's ownership.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was disposed of when retired from service.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset, if applicable. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: gasb_capital_asset_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Capital Asset Category
attributes.description: GASB-compliant capital asset classification for financial reporting and compliance with governmental accounting standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: land|land_improvements|buildings|building_improvements|infrastructure|machinery_and_equipment|vehicles|construction_in_progress — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gis_feature_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this asset to its spatial representation in the Esri ArcGIS system for network modeling and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed into active operational service and began contributing to utility operations. This is the date from which depreciation typically begins.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering this asset, if separately insured.

attributes.name: insurance_value
attributes.description: Insured value or replacement cost of the asset for insurance purposes. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: last_condition_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent condition assessment or inspection performed on this asset.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed asset record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured or produced the asset.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_number
attributes.description: Asset identifier in the IBM Maximo CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), used to link financial asset records with maintenance work orders and service history.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for the asset, used for parts ordering and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current book value of the asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the carrying value on the balance sheet. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Name of the department or division responsible for operating and maintaining this asset (e.g., Water Treatment Operations, Distribution Maintenance, Fleet Management).

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was retired from active service and removed from operational use.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used in depreciation calculations. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: sap_asset_number
attributes.description: Asset master record number in SAP FI-AA (Fixed Assets) module, used for financial accounting and depreciation posting.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific asset unit.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation purposes, based on asset class standards and engineering estimates.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires for this asset.

products.name: grant
products.description: Grant master and expenditure tracking for federal, state, and local grants received by the water utility (EPA WIFIA, SRF loans, USDA Rural Development, ARPA infrastructure grants). Covers the full grant lifecycle: award metadata (grantor, program, amount, period, matching requirements, compliance conditions), drawdown schedules, and individual expenditure transactions (cost category, vendor/payroll reference, eligible/ineligible classification, drawdown request reference). Supports GASB grant accounting, single audit SEFA reporting, and grantor compliance reporting.
products.reference: EPA WIFIA / SRF Grant / GASB Grant Accounting

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Grants are administered by specific organizational cost centers (e.g., grants management, capital projects). Adding cost_center_id links the grant to its administering cost center for SAP CO integrati

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Grants are managed within specific municipal funds (grant fund, capital project fund). Adding fund_id links the grant master to its associated fund for GASB fund accounting and single audit reporting.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.territory. Business justification: EPA, SRF, and WIFIA grants are awarded for infrastructure improvements within defined service territories. The plain-text project_location is a denormalization of territory. Grant compliance reporting

attributes.name: administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the grant administrator for internal coordination and external grantor communication.

attributes.name: administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility employee responsible for administering this grant, including compliance, reporting, and drawdown coordination.

attributes.name: administrator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the grant administrator.

attributes.name: allowable_cost_categories
attributes.description: Description of the types of costs that may be charged to the grant (e.g., 'Capital construction, engineering design, equipment acquisition, project management' or 'Operations and maintenance, personnel, supplies'). Defined in the grant agreement.

attributes.name: award_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the grant or loan award as specified in the grant agreement. For loans, this is the principal amount.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 33 - Accounting and Financial Reporting for Nonexchange Transactions

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the grant or loan was officially awarded to the utility by the grantor agency. This is the effective date of the grant agreement.

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: Five-digit CFDA number identifying the federal program (e.g., 66.458 for Capitalization Grants for Clean Water State Revolving Funds). Required for federal grants and single audit reporting.

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the grant was formally closed out with the grantor agency, including submission of final financial and performance reports.

attributes.name: compliance_conditions
attributes.description: Summary of key compliance requirements and special conditions attached to the grant (e.g., 'Davis-Bacon prevailing wage requirements, Buy America provisions, environmental review compliance, quarterly progress reporting').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grant record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the award amount (typically USD for U.S. water utilities).

attributes.name: drawdown_schedule_description
attributes.description: Description of the schedule or milestones for drawing down grant funds (e.g., 'Quarterly reimbursement based on actual expenditures', 'Milestone-based: 30% at design completion, 60% at construction midpoint, 10% at final acceptance').

attributes.name: federal_award_identification_number
attributes.description: Unique Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) assigned by the federal agency for tracking and reporting purposes. Required for federal transparency reporting (FFATA).
attributes.references: Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA)

attributes.name: first_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first loan repayment is due. Applicable only to loan-type grants.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 62 - Codification of Accounting and Financial Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: forgiveness_conditions
attributes.description: Description of conditions under which a forgivable loan may be forgiven (e.g., 'Principal forgiveness of 50% upon project completion and 5 years of compliant operation'). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: grant_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the grant project (e.g., 'Water Infrastructure Improvements Financing Act Loan for Treatment Plant Expansion', 'State Revolving Fund - Distribution System Rehabilitation').

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: External grant award number assigned by the grantor agency (e.g., EPA WIFIA loan number, SRF project number, USDA award identifier). This is the business identifier used in all external correspondence and reporting.

attributes.name: grant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grant: pending (application submitted), awarded (approved but not yet active), active (funds being drawn and spent), suspended (temporarily halted), closed (completed successfully), terminated (ended prematurely).

attributes.name: grant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grant instrument: grant (non-repayable), loan (repayable with interest), forgivable loan (repayable but may be forgiven under conditions), cooperative agreement (requires substantial federal involvement), or reimbursement (cost reimbursement basis).

attributes.name: grantor_agency_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the grantor agency (e.g., EPA, USDA, HUD) used for classification and reporting.

attributes.name: grantor_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or local agency providing the grant or loan (e.g., 'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency', 'State Water Resources Control Board', 'USDA Rural Development').

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: Approved indirect cost rate (as a percentage) that may be applied to direct costs for this grant. Based on federally negotiated indirect cost rate agreement or de minimis rate.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate for loan-type grants (e.g., SRF loans, WIFIA loans), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.5%). Zero for non-repayable grants.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 62 - Codification of Accounting and Financial Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grant record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: matching_amount_required
attributes.description: Dollar amount of local matching funds required by the grant agreement. Calculated based on matching_requirement_percentage and total project cost.

attributes.name: matching_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project costs that the utility must contribute as a match (e.g., 20.00 for a 20% local match requirement). Zero if no match is required.

attributes.name: next_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next financial or performance report is due to the grantor agency. Updated after each report submission.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to grant administration, compliance, or coordination.

attributes.name: pass_through_entity_identifying_number
attributes.description: Identifying number assigned by the pass-through entity to this subaward. Required for Single Audit reporting when applicable.

attributes.name: pass_through_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the pass-through entity if the grant is received from a state or local agency that is itself a federal grant recipient (e.g., 'State Water Resources Control Board'). Null if received directly from federal agency.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the grant period. All allowable costs must be incurred by this date. Extensions require formal amendment.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the grant period during which costs may be incurred and charged to the grant. May differ from award_date.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific grant program under which the award was made (e.g., 'Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (WIFIA)', 'Clean Water State Revolving Fund (CWSRF)', 'Drinking Water State Revolving Fund (DWSRF)', 'American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) Infrastructure Grants').

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the capital or operational project funded by this grant (e.g., 'Replacement of 5 miles of aging water distribution mains in the downtown district', 'Upgrade of wastewater treatment plant secondary clarifiers and UV disinfection system').

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Dollar amount of grant funds still available for drawdown. Calculated as award_amount minus total_amount_drawn.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 33 - Accounting and Financial Reporting for Nonexchange Transactions

attributes.name: repayment_term_months
attributes.description: Total repayment period in months for loan-type grants. Null for non-repayable grants.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 62 - Codification of Accounting and Financial Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial and performance reports must be submitted to the grantor agency (monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually, or as required by specific milestones).

attributes.name: single_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grant is subject to Single Audit Act requirements (OMB Uniform Guidance). True if the utility expends $750,000 or more in federal awards in a fiscal year.
attributes.references: Single Audit Act (2 CFR 200 Subpart F)

attributes.name: total_amount_drawn
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount of grant funds that have been drawn down or reimbursed to date. Updated as drawdown requests are processed.
attributes.references: GASB Statement No. 33 - Accounting and Financial Reporting for Nonexchange Transactions

products.name: grant_expenditure
products.description: Grant expenditure transaction recording costs charged against specific grants for reimbursement and compliance tracking. Captures grant ID, expenditure date, cost category, vendor or payroll reference, amount, eligible/ineligible classification, drawdown request reference, and federal/state reporting period. Supports grant drawdown requests, single audit Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards (SEFA), and grantor reporting.
products.reference: SEFA / OMB Uniform Guidance / GASB Grant Expenditure

attributes.name: grant_expenditure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant expenditure transaction record.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Grant expenditures are typically backed by AP invoices for vendor payments. invoice_number is a denormalized string reference to the AP invoice. Adding ap_invoice_id normalizes this and enables three-

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital or operational project to which this expenditure is assigned.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Grant expenditures are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Grant expenditures are charged against specific municipal funds (e.g., grant fund, capital fund). Adding fund_id enables fund-level grant expenditure reporting and GASB compliance. No bidirectional co

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Grant expenditures post to GL accounts. The gl_account_code STRING should be replaced with FK to general_ledger.general_ledger_id.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific grant against which this expenditure is charged.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Grant expenditures are posted to the general ledger via journal entries. Adding journal_entry_id provides direct audit trail linkage between grant expenditure transactions and their GL postings, suppo

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Grant expenditure records in water utilities must reference the originating PO for federal audit compliance (2 CFR Part 200). grant_expenditure.purchase_order_number is a denormalized text field; a pr

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Federal grant compliance (2 CFR 200 / Uniform Guidance) requires tracking which specific physical assets were funded by each grant. Linking grant_expenditure to asset registry enables grant closeout r

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom goods or services were purchased, if applicable.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Federal grant reporting (SEFA, single audit) requires grant expenditures to be tracked at WBS element level. Water utilities grant administrators must report costs by WBS element to grantor agencies (

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.work_order. Business justification: Grant-funded infrastructure projects track expenditures to specific work orders for federal/state compliance reporting, single audit requirements, and grant reimbursement documentation. Required for D

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expenditure was approved for grant charging.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the expenditure for grant charging purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual who approved this expenditure for grant charging.

attributes.name: audit_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure has been flagged in a grant audit or single audit finding.

attributes.name: audit_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or description of the audit finding associated with this expenditure, if applicable.

attributes.name: cfda_number
